Discussing deeply the protection circuit design of the asynchronous motor stalling, then the control circuit is given and the parameters of each component are selected. The parameter determination is based on rigorous theoretical analysis. With Orcad software simulation, the results prove that the design is correct.

articleTitle: 10000MW wind power in Jiangsu power system in 2020
abstract: National Development and Reform Commission of China has agreed to build 10 GW wind power base along Jiangsu coastland, which has plentiful wind power resources, and Jiangsu Province will be one of the seven wind power bases in China. Wind power's random variability is the main impact on power system, where there is higher portion of wind power, there is more impact. In this paper, from power system technical and economic point, the impact of large-scale wind power on Jiangsu power system is studied by characteristic analysis of wind power, mathematical model building and system simulation. As a result some suggestions are presented for structure of power resource, transmission network strengthening and system operation.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on the Business Model for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
abstract: A new Business Model for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations is proposed. Its main contents are the derivative products and value-added service. The power derivatives products are the kinds of current under the charging mode specification. The value-added services include the services of battery testing and fast swap and V2G contract management. Through comparative analysis of traditional business model, concluded that the new business model is more compatible, and is conducive to promoting the electric vehicle industry.

articleTitle: Framework design of smart power utilization system
abstract: Power utilization is the significant component of Smart Grid. However, existing technologies of power utilization is not systematic and have no specific program of adaptation to Smart Grid. This paper mainly studies the technical requirements and the development direction of the power utilization component in Smart Grid and puts forward a framework design of smart power utilization system that incorporates the technological features of Smart Grid, then explains the power flow and information flow and the characteristics of the system. This design constructs the microgrid of users, switches in distributed generation and optimizes the demand side management, to make the link of power utilization more economic, flexible, accessible, reliable and user-friendly.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Solutions in distribution networks Cost/Benefit analysis
abstract: Smart Grid Solution (SGS) includes equipment and support tools for efficient control and optimization of electricity distribution networks operation (SCADA/DMS solutions, communication, substation automation, field equipment, etc.). Distribution Management System (DMS) provides dynamic visualization, monitoring and control of electricity distribution network, together with a wide set of power applications for network operation analysis, planning and optimization. In this paper, the benefit of SGS/DMS implementation is investigated and evaluated (e.g. reduction of power losses, reduction of network outage costs and network development costs, improvement of power quality). At the same time, necessary investment in the installation and application of SGS/DMS is considered. Finally, the comparison of benefit and costs is analyzed and relevant conclusions are presented to manifest the profitability of SGS/DMS.

articleTitle: Research on model for photovoltaic system power forecasting
abstract: A model for photovoltaic system power forecasting is developed based on the DC physical model of photovoltaic module, which includes meteorological data processing, photovoltaic system output performance simulating, etc. Based on the model, the photovoltaic system power can be computed at any solar radiation level, ambient temperature, parameters of the photovoltaic module and time duration. Comparing to the real PV output data, the result shows this model is flexible and accurate.

articleTitle: Benefits of proper SF6 handling to reduce SF6 emissions for sustainable Electricity Transmission and Distribution
abstract: Technologies depending on Sulphur hexafluoride, as an insulation and current breaking medium, are used in high and medium voltage switchgear. Sulphur hexafluoride (SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) has a number of attractive properties for current breaking. It is a superior dielectric medium, it has very good arc-switching properties and it is chemically inert, non-toxic and non-flammable.

articleTitle: Intelligent decision system for start-up schemes based on the power-grid integrated data platform
abstract: A smart start program decision making system based on power system integrated data platform is introduced in this paper. The data platform of the power system is integrated with EMS, GIS, DAS as well as MIS for protective relaying, which abbeys IEC61970. Many obstacles are conquered with all of the new techniques, which will be described in detail.

articleTitle: Cable oversheath selection: The right material for the right application
abstract: The oversheath (jacket) of a cable provides the first line of defence for the cable during transportation, installation and throughout its life. As such the oversheath is an integral part of the cable system and choosing the appropriate material is essential to protect the cable throughout its life. This paper reviews the range of oversheath materials in use today by utilities, and will focus on which are most appropriate in particular situations. A particular emphasis will be placed on benefits of modern halogen free flame retardant (HFFR) compounds as an alternative to PVC.

articleTitle: The application of end-users' harmonic control installation
abstract: Harmonic brings all kinds of harms to the power system and the loads in parallel. This paper will demonstrate the application of the harmonic filter adding to the 35kV hybrid var compensator by introducing the reconstruction of a steel plant. The installation performs well at controlling the harmonic and improving the power quality by practicing. It's proved worth to be popularized.

articleTitle: Smart grid in residential power utilization field
abstract: Refers to the relevant standards of IEC and the case of advanced countries, combines the national conditions and network conditions, from the high reliability requirements, customer interaction, energy conservation three areas, discusses the necessity of the construction of smart grid; combines the areas of smart home, smart community, electric vehicle charging and discharging, proposes the main content of the construction of smart grid in residential power utilization field.

articleTitle: Research on harmonic control device of low voltage distribution network
abstract: The utilization of reactive power compensation devices is low caused by nonlinear harmonics load in urban low-voltage power grid. In order to improve the low voltage distribution system power quality and energy conservation reserves, practical device is tested for the harmonic and reactive power requirements of low voltage customers. This device is developed to filter out the third neutral harmonic current and fifth, seventh harmonic current and reduce the cost of harmonic filters.

articleTitle: Protection configuration research in distribution network with distributed generation
abstract: After DGs are joined in the distribution network, a series of protection problem is brought out. The cooperation of now current protection, un-conspicuous fault character at DG and problem of drop-fuse are analyzed in the paper. In order to cope with the protection problems, the protection key is indicated in the paper. Protection configuration with communication and protection configuration without communication are presented in the paper. As a result, the fiber direction protection and the intellectualized feeder protection suit to the distribution network with DGs.

articleTitle: Study on control method of cascade H-bridges active power filter for distribution system
abstract: A novel control strategy for 11-level cascade H-bridge APF based on TCPS-PWM is proposed in this paper. When the cascade inverter is applied to active power filter for distribution system, it is expected that the switching frequency and the EMI will be dramatically reduced. By the strategy, each power unit is modulated in low frequency. At the same time, the equivalent switching frequency is still high so as to meet the high tracing ability for better compensation performance. This paper also focuses on the transposing modulation method to balance the DC voltage. As each H-bridge's DC voltage is balanced under TCPS-PWM modulation, only one DC voltage is needed in practice. Then the amount of voltage transformer dramatically decreases, and the AD sampling circuit is simplified. At last, analyse and simulation show the feasibility and superiority of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Applications of GIS to Power Distribution Dispatching and analysis of technical questions
abstract: GIS (Geographic Information System) has been applied in Power Distribution Dispatching widely to improve distribution management. The application and development of GIS (Geographic Information System) in Power Distribution management not only improve the work efficiency and save the workforce strength of workers, but also bring the important meaningful instructions to the main productivity and competition. This paper firstly introduces the condition of the Power Distribution Dispatching, basic conceptions and main functions of GIS (Geographic Information System), and the requirements of GIS in term of the construction feature of power distribution. Then, the paper introduces the important applications of GIS combining the features of Power Distribution Dispatching in detail, which include the application in SCADA, MIS, and the contingency load transfer. Finally, the paper analyses the main technical questions and puts forward relevant solutions.

articleTitle: Analysis and modification of a 500kV transmission line overvoltage problem
abstract: The power frequency resonance overvoltage problem of a 500kV transmission line under non-full phase operation after installation of high voltage shunt reactor is analyzed. It is pointed out that the overvoltage problem is the result of the simultaneous action of higher compensation degree of high voltage shunt reactor, untransposition of the transmission line and improper neutral reactor value of high voltage shunt reactor. Technical measure that the transmission line should be transposed and the neutral reactor value should be rechosen is proposed. An equivalent model of tower is used to ensure the accuracy of simulation. Test results after the accomplishment of the modification project show that the proposed technical measure is effective.

articleTitle: Adaptive controller design based on neural network
abstract: Excitation control is one of the effective means to improve the stability of Power System. Excitation controller, which uses the Nonlinear characteristics and learning ability of Neural network, also the characteristics of adaptive control technology, has strong adaptability and robustness for the nonlinearity and uncertainty of the system. The simulation results to the single machine infinite bus system show that, this controller is more effective in the control, which can also ensure a higher level of voltage control and greater stability margin.

articleTitle: An object oriented real-time database storage scheme armed with dual efficient indexes
abstract: As the object oriented method appeared in the computer science field, most monitoring control systems, especially their cores, real-time databases are objected oriented designed and implemented. Conventional monitoring control systems usually construct their real-time databases based on the predefined objects as the fundamental elements. This makes them easily handled for the specialized application. But when applied to complex or even integrated applications, its efficiency, especially the real-time performance can hardly meet the requirements. Neither are their maintenance and scalability. In this paper, a new object oriented real-time database storage scheme armed with dual efficient indexes is introduced. In the scheme, the attributes rather than the objects are treated as the fundamental elements, which compose the objects determined during the configuration. Then the objects form the total real-time database storage. Both indexes on the objects and types are constructed and thus enable the flexible object oriented configuration as well as ensure the efficient real-time access in the meanwhile.

articleTitle: Investigation and practice of an intelligent system for power transformer
abstract: As the most important equipment in substation, it is necessary to make power transformer intelligence firstly in smart grids construction. According to the basic specifications of intelligent machine, i.e., visualization condition, networking control and automation, this paper presents the overall framework of a developed intelligent system for an 110kV power transformer. The structural function definition, parameter selection and diagnostic thought are introduced. Based on the frame of IEC 61850 networks, this system adopt Browser/Server structure, and a remote monitoring and control function is included. Off-line measurement and on-line monitoring is integrated using the idea of coding and decision attributions, so the accuracy and reliability of the intelligent system have been improved.

articleTitle: Research, development and application on the key technologies of intelligent dual-interactive power system
abstract: Intelligent dual-interactive power community system has been put forward to meet the requirement of intelligent power. As the vital part of smart grid, the system accomplishes the dual-interactivity between smart grid and users, which builds a solid fundament for intelligent power, community energy reduction and diminishing emission. This paper proposes a scheme of intelligent dual-interactive power community system based on PLC and micro-power wireless communication technology, which accomplishes a series of functions such as home facilities controlling, the tri-meter collection, property management and home anti-theft system etc. In addition, it has great practical significance and its social and economical benefits brought about are very significant.

articleTitle: Fuzzy multi attribute decision method research on efficiency versus reliability in distributed generation planning
abstract: When making decisions, all indices need to be appraised and compared to select the optimum project. However, planners working in power system often choose what they like according to their experiences. To get more reasonable results, comprehensive consideration of projects themselves is very necessary. So overall benefits and costs are analyzed first, such as, DG fixed costs, variable costs, customers' outage loss and projects advantages. And then a multi-attribute decision model is provided, which comprehensively considers both decision makers' subjective preference and projects' own impersonal attributes. Tests show that this method can get the optimum result and make the decision more reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on application of wireless communication technology in cable tunnels
abstract: The paper first gives a general review about the studies on the wireless communication of the cable tunnels, then analyzes the technical requirements of signal coverage in the electric power tunnel, and finally puts forward a new way of wireless intercom communication in the tunnel. In this way, several transmitters in the electric power tunnels simultaneously send the same signal over the same frequency channel and the signal covers both the area on the ground and in the tunnel. The way means forming a network with the wireless simulcasting control technology above the ground, using multiple wireless link simulcasting base stations to finish a wide range of simulcasting coverage, setting up a lot of broadcasting receiving/transmitting stations in the tunnel, arranging the directional antennas and the transfer amplifiers in the cable tunnel according to the tunnel's length, width, branching, etc, and thus achieving multi-directional uniform coverage with the same frequency in the tunnel. Forming a network between the surface and the underground, and then achieving connection between the users in the tunnel and on the ground, and communication scheduling by the dispatch center to the users.

articleTitle: Small-signal model of multiple inverter-based DG system with positive feedback anti-islanding protection
abstract: This paper presents a small-signal model suitable to analyze the stability and dynamic characteristics of multiple inverter-based distributed generation (DG) systems and the associated positive feedback anti-islanding scheme. The developed model is validated by comparing its results against those obtained by detailed, non-linear electromagnetic transient simulations. With the developed model, the sensitivity analysis can be conducted to study the small-signal stability of the multiple inverter-based DG systems.

articleTitle: Very fast over voltage simulation and analysis in 500kV GIS substation of Xiangshuijian pumped storage power station
abstract: Based on the power system simulation software DIgSILENT, this paper presents the Electro-Magnetic Transient (EMT) simulation of Very Fast Transient Overvoltage (VFTO) phenomena in 500kV GIS substation of Xiangshuijian pumped storage power station. The modeling of GIS components and its connected equipments are summarized. The operation of disconnector in GIS under different typical substation configurations is simulated. It is concluded that the highest VFTO level in the GIS substation is below 500kV substation Lightning Impulse Withstand Voltage (LIWV). The influence factors of VFTO are studied in this paper, including transformer entrance capacitance, residual charge of GIS bus conductor and the cable length between GIS and transformer. The variation regularities of VFTO level with these factors are concluded.

articleTitle: Intelligent control strategies and devices of line reactive power optimization for smart rural power gird
abstract: The dynamic compensation in rural distribution network can not only reduce the active power loss of certain lines and improve power factor, but also ameliorate each nodal voltage level. However, the switching control of dynamic compensation capacitor always depends on the parameters of installation node, namely, local control. There is no uniform scheduling, lacking a full consideration to reactive power of the entire line in rural network. An intelligent control algorithm are put forward on the condition that reactive power compensation location and capacity have been identified in rural distribution lines, which can control the capacitor switching according to the load changing and the system operation status and keep real-time voltage qualified and network loss minimum. Mathematical model of capacitors real-time switching optimization is a nonlinear mixed integer programming problem; on-line real-time control requires fast calculating speed. This paper establishes an optimal capacitor switching model aimed at a minimum network loss and improves TS algorithm to find the optimal solution to meet the requirement of computing speed according to reactive power compensation's influence on power flow and load characteristics. There must be intelligent devices to achieve the global reactive power optimal control with intelligent algorithm, which should have functions of collecting compensation node information, communicating with upper computer, and completing switch instruction. According to the exist automation conditions in rural distribution network, use technology of network and the GPRS to achieve data exchange between computer in scheduling room and each compensation devices in distribution lines. Then the computer in scheduling room will be able to dispatch on/off instruction to each compensation device according to intelligent control algorithm and information of compensation node and substation exit, achieve distribution lines reactive power compensation total optimization intelligent control, and make it a part of smart rural power grids.

articleTitle: Study on reactive power optimal control of distribution systems based on hybrid control theory
abstract: The reactive power optimal control is a multi-objective optimization problem with discrete variables in nature. The conventional control schemes are usually “time-based” which lack the flexibility for online control. Based on “event-driven” strategy, a hybrid control approach is proposed. The principle of hybrid control, system design ideas and implementation methods are introduced. The application results in Songjiang District of Shanghai City show that the proposed system can effectively eliminate all kinds of events to achieve near-optimal system state while ensuring the reliability and quality of distribution power supply and coordinating with higher-level control center.

articleTitle: Energy based contact burning diagnosis and Research of on-load tap changers
abstract: Contact burning is one of the main faults of transformer on-load tap changers (OLTC). If contact burning fault diagnosis is not timely, the decreasing contact area, increasing contact resistance and the increasing arc and heat during the witching processes will cause further burning. Researches on contact burning failure were done and a feature analysis method based on wavelet packet energy entropy of OLTC was proposed in this paper. After the comparison of the time domain vibration signal energy in the normal and fault conditions, the wavelet packet energy entropy was taken advantage to analysis the contact burning fault. Fault symptoms of OLTC were extracted by the simplified wavelet packet energy entropy. The contact burning fault can be determined by the symptoms and the results of the experiment show that this approach was feasible for the condition monitoring of OLTC.

articleTitle: Introduction power outage and voltage drop announcement system before contacting a costumer (PO-VDAS)
abstract: Low voltage power distribution lines can be developed by the expansion of cities. If location of voltage drop and power outage in distribution networks can't be identified quickly, it can cause high costs for utilization.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent fault diagnosis system for energy remote terminal unit based on agent technology
abstract: In recent years, Guangdong Power Grid Corporation has built the largest scale electric energy telemetering system in China. More than 400,000 field units had been put into use in Guangdong province. With the scale of system becoming larger, the municipal power supply bureau faces more impression of maintenance work load. In order to decrease the maintenance work load, we have designed and implemented the intelligent fault diagnosis system for field terminal unit based on multi-agent. By using multi-agent technology, the flexible intelligent communication protocol interface and optimal load balancing policy are designed to tackle the problems of various communication protocols and heavy network loads. The production rule knowledge representation is used to build diagnosis knowledge database. The system realized the function of communication monitor and on-line fault-diagnosis, which decreased maintenance work load a lot.

articleTitle: Odd-harmonic repetitive control of single phase active power filter
abstract: An odd-harmonic repetitive control (ORC) scheme is proposed for shunt active power filter (APF) to eliminate the dominant harmonic currents caused by nonlinear loads and compensate reactive currents. Compared with conventional RC, odd-harmonic RC can achieve high tracking accuracy with faster error convergence rate and smaller data memory size. Simulations results are provided to verify the validity of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on the key technology of shared modeling between digital substation and control centre
abstract: The current way of information transmission between digital substation and the control centre is traditional, which increases the amount of maintenance, and gains grid security risks, and many other defects. By comparing digital substation SCD model with control centre CIM model, this paper represents the key technology of primary equipment model mapping, measurement model mapping and SVG model import and so on, which can solve the share modeling and information sharing between digital substation and control centre.

articleTitle: An alternative energy research on hot water supply system in colleges and universities
abstract: With the rapid development of power industry and the deterioration of ecological environment, more and more people began to study alternative energy. However, in the current energy environment, the study on economic benefits and environmental benefits generated from energy alternatives isn't perfect enough, that makes energy alternatives could not get good promotion. Therefore, take hot water supply system in colleges and universities as example, this paper will specifically quantify the economic benefits and environmental benefits of alternative energy. The results show that substituting traditional fossil fuel with energy will give the community significant economic benefits and environmental benefits, worthy of promotion.

articleTitle: The research and discussion of the improvement of the reliability of urban distribution
abstract: Distribution network, as the terminal of the power transmission and distribution system, is directly connected to the power clients, the power supply reliability of which is directly related to the satisfaction of the clients' power demands. Pre-arranged power interruption and fault-caused power interruption are the two direct factors that affect the supply reliability of the urban distribution network. With overall-planning and other technologies, the influence of the pre-arranged interruption can be avoid, while that of the fault-caused interruption is unavoidable, due to irresistible force, yet the loss can be minimized by effective actions. In this paper, a method to improve city distribution network power supply reliability, based on distribution network optimization, synthetic maintenance and digitalization is proposed, which has certain significance to city distribution network planning and operation, and can also be consulted by agricultural distribution network according to local power demands in regions.

articleTitle: Comprehensive economic benefit evaluation method of transformer update based on risk assessment theory
abstract: The economic benefit evaluation of transformer update is the key issues to promote the energy-saving reconstruction of distribution systems in China. In this paper risk assessment theory is applied to evaluate the benefit of distribution transformer update. Transformer failure modes are analyzed in view of the different failure mechanisms in various operating phases and characteristics of all kinds of failure modes are introduced. Unavailability of repairable and non-repairable forced failures is separately derived based on the probability theory. Quantified unavailability is integrated with the corresponding power outage loss caused by transformer failures to calculate transformer operational risks. And the risk difference also known as risk return between old transformer and updated transformer is calculated by discrete numerical analysis. Based on payback period method, the comprehensive economic benefit model of distribution transformer update is presented by integrating the risk return,old transformer residual value,decreasing reactive power compensation cost, decreasing transmission and generating capacity investment and annual power loss saving of networks. Simulation shows that as risk return and decreasing transmission and generating capacity investment are taken into account, the payback period of transformer update project becomes greatly shorter, furthermore SH15-type transformer's energy-saving effect is superior to S13-type transformer. The proposed model is more integrated and rational than traditional evaluation methods in accord with Entire Life-Cycle Management Viewpoint and offers a new idea for economic benefit evaluation of transformer update project.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Data Acquisition and Monitoring System of Distribution Transformers Based on Broadband Technology
abstract: Based on broadband communication technology, this system has solved the problem of remote data acquisition and image monitoring of distribution transformers, realizing timely alarm, real-time data acquisition and timely load detection. By combination of analog image acquisition and digital image processing, we can receive both high-quality initial image data and high-quality storage images from monitoring center.

articleTitle: The integration technology of smart protection and control device in rural distribution network
abstract: The integration technology of smart protection and control devices in rural distribution network has been studied. A novel way of fixing high-voltage capacitor on the 10kV branch line and integrating the controller of the capacitor with the protective device of circuit breakers on the branch line is proposed. Using the load parameters of actual rural branch line to check the function of controller. The results show that the controller can cooperate with the capacitors effectively to make the Real-time and local compensation of reactive power shortfall available, and the controller can save the investment of original high voltage dynamic reactive power compensation controller. The proposed controller, which improves the investment efficiency, can improve quality of power, reduce the loss of energy and achieve intensive control at the same time.

articleTitle: Development of digital protective relay tester under IEC61850
abstract: The novel tester of digital protective relay based on IEC61850 is proposed in this paper. The tester's system architecture is based on multi-CPU (CPU+DSP) high speed hardware platform and real time operation system, it can receive and sample the analog test data on time, which is then converted into digital test data according to IEC61850 protocol. This tester also has the GOOSE trip signal which receive, the analysis digital protection device sends out,and the circuit breaker position contact signal encoding, the group frame, transmits GOOSE the switch status to give the digitized relay protection installment and so on. The transient simulation testing platform is established, which can construct the electric quantity of each test cycle in the period of protection's operation for sending under IEC61850. Due to the special recursive algorithm and detecting the action of protection,the tester can complete the closed loop experiment of tripping-reclose-tripping forever. With the help of man machine interface, it's very convenient to performance dynamic simulation test, static simulation test and transient simulation test. This tester also get the fine results in the check of transient simulation test.

articleTitle: The analysis of specific grounding fault and Petersen on ARC grounding out arc
abstract: 10KV-35KV Medium Voltage Distribution Network neutral point grounding modes choice is a systems engineering. When ARC grounding fault happens, neutral through Petersen coil can carry out effective blow has always been a focus. By arc grounding in the neutral through Petersen coil process, Results are as long as proper control of relative roughness. Neutral through Arc - suppression coil grounding ways to better control of ARC grounding fault without affecting the reliability of power supply. Study on small current earth fault line selection and field failure data of monitoring and control system of records. Analysis of intermittent arc grounding and unbalanced current grounding and development of grounding and the cause of formation of ring earth fault and fault phenomenon and zero - sequence voltage and current situation. Description of single - phase to ground fault in small current grounding system is a complex one, development and the process of change. Only attaches importance to this process is enough to improve the reliability and accuracy of line selection.

articleTitle: A decision support system for economically optimal plan of distributed energy systems
abstract: Planning of distributed energy systems is a challenging task, involving a lot of technical, economic, environmental and political factors. In this study, an optimization model based decision support system and the relevant software package have been developed to provide comprehensive analysis of economic, energetic and environmental issues within a distributed energy system framework. The optimization problem is formulated as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model where the objective is to minimize the overall cost of the distributed energy system including both investing and running costs. By using a user friendly interface, the system can be used without the necessary to have special expertise and knowledge on energy system planning and decision analysis. In addition, besides the distributed energy system planning, it can be also used for examining and visualizing impacts of local energy and environmental policies, regional development policies, and climate change within a local framework.

articleTitle: Chances and challenges for smart grids in distribution
abstract: The structure and the task of electricity supply systems will dramatically change in the near future. Distribution systems are characterised by a large number of equipment and difficult access in urban and industrial environment. Therefore any modification has to be planned carefully and flexible solutions which are open for further improvement have to be selected. Based on the importance and the performance of electrical distribution systems the chances and the challenges for future distribution systems will be presented. Special emphasis is given on the new active components in distribution such as distributed generation and customers with smart meters. In addition to the standard components of electricity supply systems the need for communication and overlaying control systems is rising. As an example for an urban smart grid, the project “Masdar City” in Abu Dhabi is introduced. The main target to realize an example of the city of the future for 100'000 inhabitants, where all energy consumed is generated from renewable resources.

articleTitle: Research on cost-benefit analysis and evaluation of regional distribution network planning
abstract: According to the difficulty of separation and calculation for cost and benefit of distribution network planning, the model of incremental cost-benefit evaluation is established. In the model, the planning projects are regarded as the extending projects of original power grid. Cost is incremental cost caused by the planning investment and benefit is incremental benefit caused by incremental electricity sale. The theory of capital time value is used to evaluate the economy by calculating NPV. Shijiazhuang distribution network planning is used to verify the validity of the model and the result shows that the model has great practical value.

articleTitle: Proportional-resonant current control of single-phase grid-tied PV inverter system
abstract: In this paper, a proportional resonant (PR) control scheme is proposed for single-phase grid-tied boost-buck PV inverter to achieve high-quality sinusoidal output current. Simulation results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Power harmonic analysis based on Orthogonal Trigonometric Functions Family
abstract: Harmonic detection is the basis of harmonic issues and harmonic detection method is the key of harmonic measurement. Based on Fourier Transform and Wavelet Transform, ways and means of detecting and analyzing are developed, but both of them have the problem of spectrum leakage. In this paper, a novel power harmonic algorithm based on the family of trigonometric functions is developed for the characterization of harmonics. The algorithm has designed a set of discrete reference signals and only estimated the amplitudes and the phases which are needed. Besides it hasn't been involved in the influence of the leakage, this algorithm is also easy to carry out and has much high resolution precision than the traditional Fourier algorithm and Wavelet algorithm. The algorithm also has the characteristic of being more sensitive to sampling frequency and less sensitive to sampling points. Using this characteristic, the algorithm can adjust sampling parameters in order to give consideration to both precision and real-time performance. The simulation results have proved that the outstanding advantage of the algorithm is that when chosen a proper sampling frequency the algorithm can pick out harmonics components with high precision in very few fundamental periods. Comparing with Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), Windowed-FFT and Wavelet Package Transform, the algorithm has its certain advantage.

articleTitle: Research on the parallel hybrid active power filter
abstract: Many problems are caused by harmonic pollution, such as lower power factor and bigger loss, even power system will be paralytic. In order to solve the above problems, the most effective strategy of improving electric quality is adopts the APF that can compensate harmonics dynamicly. This paper presents an improved type of parallel hybrid active power filter structure, using compound control method, can be a good solution to the capacity-constrained active power filter issue.

articleTitle: Forward/backward sweep method based on map structure for power flow calculation of distribution system
abstract: Power flow calculation is very important to distribution system management, and more and more attention are paid to calculation speed and accuracy due to the booming smart grids which allow interconnection of distributed generation of different kinds. A new forward/backward sweep method based on map structure is presented, which can calculate power flow of all complex radial distribution systems. Special coding of nodes, such as hierarchical coding, is not necessary, and results can be obtained directly through a global search of line map. Test shows that the method is timesaving and insensitive to the system scale, which helps the popularity of smart grids.

articleTitle: Resarch on daily low-voltage line loss management based on visualization
abstract: This paper discusses how to manage the low-voltage line loss which is used by the visualization, thereby assists power enterprises in reducing the low-voltage line loss. According to the characteristic of the low-voltage grid, change the managed object to the customers and transformers district, time to the daily data. And discusses how to calculate and analyze the line loss. About visualization, analyzes the advantages and shortcuts of GIS (Geographic Information System), which will not be convenient in the line loss management, and use circuit diagram to achieve the goal of visualization based on the FLEX for a substitute.

articleTitle: The research on the method of condition estimate of power transformer base on support vector machine
abstract: The transformer condition estimate model is constructed based on SVM and the parameter for SVM-based classifier is determined by adopting cross validation method. Considering the compactness characteristics of DGA data and combining the own characteristics of SVM, a method of fuzzy C-means clustering to pre-select representative samples is presented. Simulation results show that, the pre-selection of representative samples could solve the problem of time consuming on parameter determination and enable to detect transformer faults with higher diagnosis accuracy. The combination of fuzzy clustering method with SVM is also helpful to other pattern recognition problems.

articleTitle: The research, test and verification of the HVDC centralized control system
abstract: The necessity of the HVDC centralized control system is analyzed, and studies confirm its feasibility. Building a HVDC centralized control system to integrate all of the independent HVDC systems, is helpful to: (1) reducing the requirements of human resources and equipments, centralizing and strengthening the maintenance team, enhancing maintenance capabilities internally, (2) achieving the state of centralized monitoring-controlling and the high-level coordinate control with synthesized and optimized strategy. The designing principles of the centralized control centre are studied, and the key technologies need be verified are determined. To determining the HVDC centralized control system's feasibility and implementation procedure, it is necessary to build an appropriately simplified test system to verify all the involved software and hardware, the communication network, and the project organization and implementation procedure, carefully. The test tells, (1) The set of the HVDC centralized control system will not affect the safe operation of the original SCADA system in the converter station, but will get a backup system one more. (2) The HVDC centralized control system can receive all real-time data and SERs that are consistent with the original SCADA system without lost, (3) and can successfully execute all kinds of the HVDC control types such as deblocking the HVDC system and putting it into operation. (4) Based on the network communication middleware, the delay (<;20ms) of the data transmission is in a range that can not be sensed. With a huge amount of data, the 2M-channel fully meet the real-time requirements of the transmission of data and commands (normally about 7.9KBps, in fault 20.9KBps) in the bandwidth test. (5) Benefitting from the distributed software architecture, the HVDC centralized control system can effectively withstand the stress test (18,000 data/second, CPU load rate <;22%) caused by simulated faults happened in all existing and planned HVDC systems (10 converter stations) at the same time.

articleTitle: The prospect for the relay protection work in the smart electric distribution network
abstract: The State Grid has got great breakthrough in Ultra-high Voltage, building the strong smart grid is a new great transformation and innovation in the grid development, and the smart electric distribution network is an important part of the smart grid strategy. According to the goals of building a unified strong smart grid, this paper discusses the develop trends of the protection system in the smart electric distribution network. Combining with the working status of the relay protection in a power supply company, this paper gives some prospect of the relay protection working in the smart electric distribution network, it is a exploration about the future works of the Relay Class in the smart electric distribution network.

articleTitle: Study on selection of transformer capacity and conductor cross-section related to 20kV network in high voltage distribution network
abstract: With the rapidly increase of electric load in urban areas, the advantage of 20kV network is more obvious such as capacity of electric power supply, place of transformer substation and power supply radius. In the other hand, it is different from 10kV network in substation planning and method of operation. We need study on the equipment selection in high voltage distribution network. Through the calculation model of equipment selection, we got the most optimal selection of transformer capacity and conductor cross-section under several kinds of connection mode. The method has proved useful to the equipment selection of urban distribution networks in which 20kV is the middle voltage level.

articleTitle: Research about online security warning and risk assessment of power grid based on Energy Management System
abstract: In this paper, online security warning and risk assessment of power grid are proposed, based on date from Energy Management System(EMS), combined with information about real-time operation state, component status and external operating environment. It condenses the two factors, contingency likelihood and severity, that determine system reliability, into risk indices on different loads and operation modes, which provide precise evaluation of the power grid's security performance. Through these indices, we can know about the vulnerable area of the system and whether the normal operating mode or repair mode is over-limited or not, and provide decision -making support for dispatchers. Common cause outage and equipment-aging are considered in terms of the establishment of outage model. Multiple risk indices are defined in order to reflect the risk level of the power grid more comprehensively.

articleTitle: Research on conduction mechanism of cross-regional and cross-provincial transmission price
abstract: This paper analyzes the diversification of conduction methods of cross-regional and cross-provincial transmission price and the status of the coexistence of a variety of ways in China currently, puts over the problem caused by the current status of the coexistence of a variety of ways, finds out that our country has so far failed to adapt to conduction mechanism of transmission price of the development of three-level electricity grid. The transmission costs of electricity grid of cross region and province travel down to the next stage in different ways, which leads to the non-uniform of internal management and the criticism of external regulation, will hardly be transmitted to the end-user reasonably, timely, effectively and fully. It will lead that the investment of cross-regional and cross-provincial power grid cannot obtain a reasonable return, then affect the development of cross-regional and cross-provincial power grid, ultimately affect the capacity of optimal allocation of energy resources. This paper further improves the existing electricity transmission and distribution price system, classifies the transmission costs of cross-regional and cross-provincial electricity grid by function. The costs associated with the transmission will be recovered through the transmission capacity and price. The costs associated with the security issues and so on will be shared by the benefited provincial power grid and recovered through the sales price. This paper regulates the behavior of charging of cross-regional and cross-provincial electricity grid, reduces the transmission price suitably, and promotes the electricity trades of cross region and province. The conduction mechanism of the price is established according to per transmission capacity and per kilometer by the main management body. In addition, the other conduction mechanism is also established and not based on the main management body. The established conduction mechanism of cross-regional and cross-provincial transmission price can change the way of energy transmission, promote the optimal allocation of energy resources, and promote coordinated and sustainable development of China's local economic, make companies implement the group operation, also allow the individual and subject in the transmission pricing chain to avoid risk.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of family energy management system facing the intelligent power
abstract: Based on the construction of intelligent electrical pilot in the state grid corporation of China, fully grasp the requirements of intelligent power demand management, intelligent network based on the research of smart grid-oriented Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), we design and realize the family comprehensive energy management system for the power users. Based on the family network which is composed of smart meters, intelligent terminals, intelligent sockets and other smart devices, the system can access and measure distributed power sources and electric cars, monitor the comprehensive energy consumption and optimize the family energy management, realize intelligent control of household appliances and the two-way interaction with users. AMI system provides powerful technical support for the construction of new interactive relationship in which energy information and traffic flows real-timely between company and customers, and meet the demand of the advanced technology, economic efficiency, flexible and diverse services, the requirements of opening, friendly to actively development.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization control considering actual operating mode transfer
abstract: This paper takes into account the effect of the transfer of power grid operation mode during the study on reactive power optimization control. And it is proposed that a multi-objective reactive power optimization model including transformer stalls, constraints in the operation mode transfer process, the reactor and so on. The iterative algorithm of optimization and power flow calculation is used to calculate it. The case studies validate the proposed algorithm is effective and robust.

articleTitle: IEC 61970 CIM/CIS in power dispatching automation system standard conformance test technology research
abstract: This paper researches dispatching automation system, IEC 61970 CIM/CIS standard compliance testing technology. The effective implementation of compliance testing can dispatching automation system, construction, maintenance and upgrading of all levels of dispatching automation system model sharing, information sharing play a positive role in promoting.

articleTitle: A communication middleware based on concurrent real-time database
abstract: In Power SCADA system, real-time database is regarded as the kernel of the whole architecture. Based on the features of current main products in this field, the paper prompt a new structure with setting up a real-time database on each network node and provide a communication mechanism for all databases synchronization, then appraise this new structure by comparing with other main products designs.

articleTitle: Application of cooperative game analysis in combination evaluation of power quality
abstract: Cooperative game theory is firstly introduced into the comprehensive assessment of power quality, and a new model for combination evaluation of power quality is established based on cooperative game. The model takes into account the advantages of 4 kinds of single assessment method. By calculating the characteristic function values of various combinations to get the Shapley value of each assessment method, and then the weight value of each method in combination union can be determined, so that power quality assessment conclusion could be optimized. The conclusion also reflects the information of evaluation object from different angles. The simulation results show that the combination evaluation method with good accuracy can be effectively applied to the comprehensive assessment of power quality.

articleTitle: Impact of abnormality of bus coupler TWJ on dead-zone protection of bus coupler
abstract: In the testing of bus protection,it is found that the dead-zone protection of coupler will fail to operate when bus coupler TWJ cannot act correctly for the reason of contact adherence or jam. By analyzing of the theory and logic diagram of dead-zone protection of coupler, it is presented that the cause of incorrect action of dead-zone protection of coupler is that the bus coupler current is not excluded from the differential bus protection correctly. A new method is proposed to avoid this defect by the leading-in of bus coupler HWJ, then the improved logic diagram is given and analyzed. The analysis results show that the practical engineering value of this method is great because the rejecting operation of dead-zone protection can be avoided and the operation time of protection can be shortened by using it.

articleTitle: Application of neural network and DS evidence fusion algorithm in power transformer fault diagnosis
abstract: As the transformer's fault types and fault positions are complexity, complementarity, redundancy and strong characteristics of uncertainty, a satisfactory diagnosis of transformer fault types and fault position may not be obtained if only one technique is used. In this paper, a synthetic diagnosis method using neural network and DS evidence theory for transformer fault diagnosis is presented, combining DGA data with application of data fusion theory. This method has advantage of both neural and DS evidential theory, it can effectively solve the problem of uncertainty, and improve the fault diagnosis system's accuracy and reliability. A simulation example in this paper illustrates that the method combing of neural network with DS evidence theory is indeed greatly improved integration of the credibility of the data, making diagnostic systems easy to design, high precision and prone to operation. It can fulfill users' requirement perfectly.

articleTitle: The dynamic simulation research on application of SVC in the south Hebei power grid
abstract: The static var compensator (SVC) can realize two-direction, continuous, and quick adjustment of reactive power, and it is its prominent features. SVC is recognized as the most remarkable device for voltage control, stabilization and damped oscillation of power system. According to the features of the south Hebei power grid, against partial power system which is impacted by stronger load, and the wind farm of which output power is influenced hardly by natural resources, plenty of simulation analyses about cut-in SVC are performed in this paper. The result proved that SVC can reduce the pulsation of partial voltage, and improve the quality of electric energy.

articleTitle: Analysis for calculation method of shielding flashover rate on common-tower double transmission line
abstract: Based on the EGM (electric geometry method), some problems when calculating the ratio of exposure arc to exposure arc and shielding arc, exposure arc projection, striking distance coefficient, shielding failure flashover rate etc are analyzed and discussed. It points out that the general maximum striking distance formula is not appropriate for some conditions. Calculating shielding failure flashover rate by current density probability function is proposed; It also suggested that three phase conductors use corresponding striking distance coefficient with the conductor height.

articleTitle: Revolution brought by DER to intelligent marketing
abstract: Rapid development and large-scale application of distributed energy resources (DER for short) will bring new opportunities and challenges to intelligent marketing. Based on technology roadmap of smart grid, the developmental outlook of DER is proposed. Some new concepts are introduced which contain information management of three-level control, principle of power-consumed, virtual marketing, and demand-side guidance with distributed generation units. Revolution brought by DER to intelligent marketing is emphatically elaborated. Finally, in connection with hotspot issues, such as the vision of smart grid, energy-use, deep thinking is made with the participation of DER, and their modeling, access rights and other issues are introduced in order to discuss the prospects and research directions of intelligent marketing under the framework of DER.

articleTitle: Voltage stability and optimum energy saving control of distribution power network
abstract: Distribution power network voltage stability and optimum energy saving control is basically brought out by Real-time-monitoring and on-line optimal calculation on reactive voltage of the transmission and distribution power network. The mathematical model of the optimum control of the reactive voltage is built and the principle of the method is analyzed. The structure of the control system of the optimal operation of reactive voltage is introduced which is 10 kV and lower voltage level distribution power network.

articleTitle: Comparison and selection of high-voltage large-capacity D-STATCOM main circuit
abstract: In view of analysis and comparison of present high-voltage large-capacity D-STATCOM circuit structure, especially advantages and disadvantages of Δ-cascaded structure and Y-cascaded structure, then it proposes and describes a Y-cascaded structure, the link of which is composed of two back-to-back H converters. Current compensation algorithm based on coordinate αβ conversion, fault links bypass tolerance, and its correlative CPS-SPWM are proposed respectively, the experimental results of 1.14kV/100kVA prototype testify the validity and the effectivity of the proposed structure and algorithm.

articleTitle: Power quality online monitoring system based on transparent forwarding
abstract: In this paper, The architecture, communication implementation, technical characteristics, management systems and applications etc. of the online power quality monitoring system, which is based on transparent forwarding technique, are described. The system would have good application prospects for its strong compatibility, scalability, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Diagnosis for loose switching contact fault of on-load tap-changer in transformer
abstract: With the increasing requirements of power quality, adjusting voltage frequency and cumulative voltage regulation frequency are increasing for on-load tap-changing transformer, which makes the fault rate of on-load tap-changers(OLTC) in power transformer constantly raise. Contact loosing fault is a common fault for OLTC, which has been paid more attention in recent years. But so far, no effective diagnostic method has been found and the number of fault is increasing. So it is very important to find an effective on-line diagnostic method for OLTC. In this paper, for vibration signal made by contact closing, author applied wavelet packet energy entropy method to analyze the value of wavelet packet energy entropy for vibration signal during the period of contact closing when the on-load tap-changer works. The author found an apparent fault feature which was that the standard entropy of NO.2 node was clearly very high in wavelet packet energy entropy when the contact was loose (up to 3 times more than normal). Base on the theoretical analysis, the author experiment the OLTC which was widely used by Jiangsu Electric Power Company at working environment joined with HuaMing Power Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The result validates the feasibility of co-diagnosis algorithm. In addition, the diagnostic algorithm can not only discover the potential contact loose fault of OLTC quickly and effectively, but also can distinguish the contact off fault and contact burned fault to some extent, which provide an important reference for engineering staff to solve the problem timely and effectively.

articleTitle: Voltage dip immunity of equipment and installations - status and need for further work
abstract: This paper presents the results from the work of WG C4.110, a joint working group by CIGRE, CIRED and UIE. Its mandate period stretched from early 2006 through early 2009. The group has addressed several aspects of the immunity of, especially, industrial equipment against voltage dips. Compared to the work earlier groups, the equipment performance is not seen as a final aim, but as a step towards the ultimate aim: allowing the process to ride through the voltage dip. Some of the contributions and conclusions from the WG C4.110 are discussed in this paper, (1) Description of voltage dips, (2) Equipment and process immunity, (3) Testing and characterization, (4) Economics, (5) Immunity classes and application, (6) Further work.

articleTitle: Power transmission tower type determining method based on aerial image analysis
abstract: Using helicopter aerial inspection of power transmission line is an effective measure in complicated geographical environment. At the present time, the inspection of the aerial image rely on manual observation, its efficiency is low and undetected always happen by mistake or careless. An automatic analysis method by computer has been proposed to process aerial video. After pretreatment, the image quality has improved. Edge detection is utilized to determine the target area of the image, and tower contours is obtained by curve fitting. Based on variety tower features, template matching method is used to identify the power transmission tower type. The analysis results of the aerial image showed that the identification method is feasible. It can greatly reduce the labor burden of inspection, and improve the efficiency of aerial image analyzing.

articleTitle: Research on utilization ratio of grid-connected distributed solar photovoltaic sources
abstract: To effectively accept the grid-connected distributed solar photovoltaic (PV) output, PV utilization ratio is researched based on the system minimum load at various PV penetrations. The impacts of PV on the electric power system and the main constraints for PV connected to the grid are analyzed. The methods to calculate PV utilization ratio, PV generation cost and annual utilization hours are proposed. The acceptable capacity and utilization of PV can be evaluated by these parameters. Finally, constructive suggestions for optimizing the scheme of PV installation and improving the acceptable capacity of PV are provided.

articleTitle: Study on the icing process of transmission lines and the local meteorological parameters
abstract: Meteorology is an important factor to the icing of power system. The study on meteorology and icing was delayed for absence of the effective scene icing data. An On-line Monitoring System of Transmission Line Conductor Icing Based on GSM SMS was designed and produced, by which the local meteorology, such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction, rain and snow, air pressure etc., and the icing status, such as gravity of the iced conductor, the thickness of icing coating, the frequency of gallop etc. can be measured in time. The study on meteorology and icing was made based on the scene icing data. The results show that the formation and dropping of icing of transmission lines was related to the special meteorology, such as the temperature between −10°C and 0°C, the humidity large than 80%, the wind speed less than 10m/s, and the stationary wind direction, that reliability of forecasting icing is very poor according to a single meteorology, and the error is very large. The error is 248% when the temperature is used only to forecasting icing. The accuracy, error, failure of forecasting icing is 67%, 18% and 39% when some meteorology are used together. The accuracy, error, failure of forecasting icing is 86%, 13% and 3% when the fuzzy theory is used.

articleTitle: Subsynchronous oscillations study of non-parallel operating AC/DC system with series capacitor
abstract: The first non-parallel operating AC/DC system with series capacitor being constructed in China is hybrid of the Hulunbeier-Liaoning ±500 kV HVDC lines and Yimin-Fengtun 500 kV AC transmission system. Its subsynchronous oscillation problem become complex because of the mutual effect of series capacitor compensation and HVDC. In order to analyze the SSO characteristic of this new grid structure, six cases derived from original system have been adopted: the islanded operating HVDC (Hulunbeier-Liaoning) system, the AC (Yimin-Fengtun) system without series capacitor and HVDC lines, the AC system with FSC and HVDC lines, the AC system with FSC+TCSC(two control strategy) and HVDC lines. Through the simulation of shaft torque and rotational speed of studied generators with multimass in different faults situations, the results show that the non-parallel operating AC/DC system can mitigate SSO caused by HVDC or FSC. The system characteristic is in association with the system structure, compensation type and control strategy of TCSC..

articleTitle: Operation economy analysis of the chilled water storage reform programs on central air conditioning system of a building
abstract: In this paper, a chilled water storage reconstruction program and its running strategy were proposed combining with the result of energy efficiency test on a building central air conditioning system, and compared operation cost before and after the reconstruction under the running condition and cooling load during test. The analysis results showed that the implementation of this reconstruction program will not only shift some load during the day but also can significantly save operation costs.

articleTitle: Distribution network planning principles and design models considering distributed generations
abstract: A reliability calculation method which can consider distributed generations' output characteristic was proposed. Using this method, reliability and assets utilization were analyzed for distribution systems and DGs' impact and contribution was calculated quantitatively. Furthermore, some planning principles and design scenarios were proposed for distribution network with DGs. By the study case on which the principles were applied, it is proved that DGs have an overall benefit for increasing system reliability while saving network construction costs.

articleTitle: Power cable rating models and their applications
abstract: The principles, classifications and features of power cable rating models are studied in this paper,and several useful models and their applications are analyzed. Especially SCR cable model, DCR cable model and a synthetic analysis approach are introduced, which could be used for design, online monitoring and optimization of cable systems. An application case is provided.

articleTitle: Low voltage distribution network noise analysis based on empirical mode decomposition
abstract: Low voltage power line communication is a popular choice in electrical information transmission. Since power lines are devised for transmission of power at 50-60 Hz and at most 400 Hz, the use this medium for data transmission, at high frequencies, presents some technically challenging problems. Besides large attenuation, power line is one of the most electrically contaminated environments, which makes communication extremely difficulty. Traditional algorithms are short in distribution network noise analysis as its characteristic of wide frequency and abundant pulse components. A distribution network noise analysis algorithm based on empirical mode decomposition is proposed in this paper. This algorithm can improve the adaptation capability in different time scales by utility of empirical mode decomposition. The results of verification had shown this algorithm were precise in 220V power line noise decomposition, and provided a technology support in further noise model establishment.

articleTitle: Power quality of network was improved via delicacy management method
abstract: Voltage was an important index of power quality of network. In order to improve the power quality of network, Jiangsu Yixing Electrical Supply Co., Ltd relies on centralized control system for voltage and reactive power optimization, through comprehensive analysis about the eligible rate of busbar voltage, the management process of the eligible rate of busbar voltage of transformer substation was improved, and a series of analysis control tactics about the eligible rate of busbar voltage was formed. The level of management on voltage was improved further, through converting it into pre-control after the problem happens. This achievement was awarded the golden medal by the national quality inspection association, which has a certain promotional value.

articleTitle: Circuit loss analysis and application development of three-phase unbalanced load of low voltage distribution network
abstract: The three-phase unbalanced load of low voltage area will do harm to the electrical equipment and will increase the technical circuit loss. In this paper, the rms current method is used to deduce relationship between unbalance degree and the rate of increase current loss of three-phase unbalanced lines, as well as the solution of increase current loss of everyday. Use the increase of current loss of the typical day to evaluate the loss of a month, finally, in order to deal mount of data, we develop an application, which is proved rationality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Smart distribution network of inter-harmonic detection research
abstract: Since the development of smart distribution networks, power electronic interface has been widely used, the harm caused by the inter-harmonics between the more and more attention has been paid. Governance inter- harmonics in the power system, the premise is an accurate analysis of the spectrum between the inter- harmonics. Because Gaussian noise can be completely inhibited by higher-order cumulant, MUSIC algorithm, based on Fourth-order cumulant can be better applied to weak inter-harmonic signal extraction than traditional MUSIC algorithm, to obtain accurate harmonic power spectrum and frequency of the source. Characteristics of the power harmonic are made an accurate analysis by Amplitude calculated using Prony method. This method is verifed by simulation, which can accurate detective the inter-harmonic components and a number of inter- harmonic beside frequency in a short time.

articleTitle: A novel state estimation method based on topological contraction for distribution networks
abstract: A practical SE (state estimation) method based on multiple data source is proposed. With the help of Decision Theory the bad data identification method which combines the historical data and remote data from IDP (Integrated Data Platform) and 6 data rules are proposed. A logical judgment based on the 6 data rules is conducted, and the data quality evaluation method is established accordingly. The data repairing improves the quality of the input data for state estimation. The weighed least-square state (WLS) estimation takes into account the reliability of the measurements, reducing the influence of bad data. Research shows that this method is superior to traditional state estimation methods in that it tackles with bad data more efficiently, resulting in more compatible state information for advanced applications. Experiments in the distribution network of DBC of Shanghai Pudong District prove the method is reliable and efficient.

articleTitle: Power distribution network planning optimization based on life cycle cost (LCC)
abstract: Combined with the characteristics of conventional distribution network planning, this article proposed a new power distribution network planning optimization method that based on the minimum life cycle cost (LCC) to decide distribution network planning scheme. The life cycle cost calculation model for distribution network planning scheme is made on the premise that the power network operate safely and steadily, in order to obtain the minimum life cycle cost (LCC) as the objective function and use the multi-particle swarms cooperative optimization algorithm to optimize the distribution network path planning, while according to comparative analysis of different layout patterns of switch with LCC to obtain the minimum LCC planning scheme. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified by the result of applying it to a test system.

articleTitle: The research on under-voltage load shedding based on voltage-reactive power sensitivity in power system
abstract: This paper puts forward an approach that applies active margin, sensitivity index, and N-1, N-2-voltage scanning of the network to search the voltage weak areas, based on the mechanism analysis of the voltage instability and collapse. The installation locations of under-voltage load shedding devices are determined through the voltage weak areas. On this basis, a setting method based on voltage-reactive power sensitivity is put forward. The simulation results verify the validity and practicality of the method, using the actual data of some one province network of China.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the object-oriented EMS real-time database
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of one object-oriented EMS real-time database. The database is constructed by the dynamic modeling technology based on the meta-data and meta-rules, conforms to IEC61970 standard. Compare to the relational and hierarchical database, the object-oriented database has the better openness and interoperability. The dynamic modeling technology based on the meta-data and meta-rules is that in which the object models are created completely on the most basic data medium--- meta-data and the most basic method which describe relations ---meta-rules. The technology can construct various application objects in the different fields. Based on this dynamic modeling technology, the models are constructed by dynamic-modeling tool. The data models can be created and modified without programming by this tool. That improves the stability of system greatly. In the process of design and develop of the EMS database, the hierarchical characteristic of power system and the characteristic of dynamic modeling technology are all be considered to design the objects and attributes what raise the queries and access speed. The real time database uses the parallel databases cloning technology which solves the problem of data coupling between multi-applications. Based on the cloning technology, the polymorphism database is provided which can meet the requirement of multi-study and multi-application. Through testing, the database can fill the requirements of the real power system.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization in power system based on chaos ant colony algorithm
abstract: A novel co-operative agents approach, ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm, for solving problems of combinatorial optimization, is put forward by M. Dorigo. The main characteristics of ACO are positive feedback, distributed computation. Preliminary study has shown that it has many promising futures. This paper reviews recent work on ant algorithms and applications, the chaos ant colony optimization (CACO) algorithm is used in reactive power optimization problem in electric power system. The model of reactive power optimization is established taking the minimum network losses as the objective. Its validity is verified through arithmetic examples of IEEE30 node and the practical area network of Puyang city.

articleTitle: A new harmonics/inter-harmonics detection approach based on leakage estimation
abstract: A separation approach for harmonics and inter-harmonics detection and measurement in power system which complies with the recommendations of the IEC standard is proposed in this paper. The separation technique is based on the estimation of leakage values at harmonic frequencies caused by all the main inter-harmonics. By subtracting the estimated leakage values from the original spectrum, harmonic components can be obtained without the leakage effect due to the main inter-harmonics. Then the inter-harmonics can be detected by subtracting the harmonics from the original sampled points. Based on the analysis results of simulations and the real world case, it shows that the proposed method is effective to eliminate the calculation errors caused by the spectral interference between harmonics and inter-harmonics even when their frequency differences are less than one frequency resolution.

articleTitle: Study on the layout of 220kV substation with all cables inlet and outlet
abstract: As the development of local economy and the expanding of urban zone, the overhead electric transmission lines of every voltage are all limited to a certain extent. Consider of the city planning and huge electricity requirement, 220kV substation with all cables inlet and outlet are experimented and extended step by step in Wuxi, adopting 240MVA high capacity transformer and 2500mm2 cross-linked cables, and their design and construction are both at exploration stage. This article simply studies on the layout of substations already in operation, construction and design, and provides some approach for the similar substations' design in the future.

articleTitle: The realization for on-line examination system of relay protection in power system
abstract: Reference construction program for on-line examination of relay protection in power system of Qinghai Electric Power Corporation, and combined with relevant research data and results, the paper discussed the different realizations for on-line examination of relay protection in power system, and compare on the data sources and functions realization in particular for different programs. This paper also proposed the technical difficulties for on-line examination of relay protection in power system and given viable solutions.

articleTitle: Key technologies and test method of Remote Terminal in intelligent distribution automation system
abstract: Around the distribution automation reliability, real-time, safety, operability and maintenance of the basic requirements, a detailed analysis of the five areas, such as structure and safety design, function, performance, electrical and magnetic properties and the main station communications etc, are putted forward to explain the key technologies of intelligent distribution automation terminal. The paper also bring forward a set of effective and practical testing techniques on the system and the targeted building blocks, mainly including the main fault simulation testing, signal avalanche testing, remote mutation testing, measure data change testing, electrical and magnetic properties testing and master site communications testing technologies. Through practical application Experience, it was showed that this test technology could finish the whole system test or the functional modules test of system and find the defects in each functional module to Enhance the construction, inspection, testing and maintenance levels of distribution automation system in the future.

articleTitle: The key technologies research of power network model combination based IEC61970
abstract: IEC 61970 is the international standard of the control center's intercommunion. On the basis of this standard, we analyzed the specialty of model combination, and discussed specially for its key technologies, including model verify based on electric system rules, equipments' distinguish with control precinct based on borders define, and creating the increment model based on the model difference. At the same time, we discussed a model management on the base of editions for the model combination's application. At last, there is an introduction for achievement of model combination's progress in China now.

articleTitle: Research on combined methods of harmonics filtering
