abstract: Based on the data of Jinxi Electric Substation of Lishui Power System (including its power net topology, parameters, harmonic sources and the field testing harmonic data in period of 16/06/2004 19:56:00-17/06/2004 09:15:00), the combined approaches of harmonic filtering are analyzed.

articleTitle: The research on communication standard framework of smart grid
abstract: At first, the current communication standards of electrical power system are analyzed in this paper. These communication standards have many drawbacks. (1) There are too many standards. Their compatibilities are not very good. It increases the complexity of system integration and raises the cost. (2) They can not meet the new requirements of smart grid. (3) Many private protocols were applied. Then the requirements of communication standards of smart grid are analyzed, the technical principles are provided. The initial smart grid interoperability standards framework (Release 1.0) provided by the Department of Energy of USA is analyzed. The technical principles of the framework are studied. The solution for the communication standard framework for Chinese smart grid is provided. The technical principles are given. (1) The new standards should be developed based on the current standards. (2) The scope of framework should broad enough. (3) The security of communication should been paid more attention on. (4) The vendors of devices should be encouraged applies the new standards. (5) The testing and certification should been conducted by the third party. At last, the advices on the selection of standards used in the generation, transmission, transformation, distribution, consumption and dispatching are given.

articleTitle: System voltage regulation of power grid based on synchronous generator's leading phase operation
abstract: This paper discusses the necessity of synchronous generator leading phase operation adjusting voltage, combined with Jiangsu power grid generator leading phase operation experiment situation. It proposed that generator leading phase operation is a convenient and economic voltage regulation means of power grid. Characteristics of 600 MW synchronous generator leading phase operation are studied through many experiments, the main restriction factors of large generator leading phase operation are analyzed. At last, the paper put forward a new concept that multi-generators coordinate integral leading phase operation, and look forward to the future research direction.

articleTitle: High quality inverter-based distributed power supply system collocating SVC
abstract: Configuration of static var compensator (SVC) in the distributed grid with DGs is a widely adopted and effective measure to improve the power quality. As SVC itself is harmonic source, the paper proposed to add harmonic compensation link in the current inner loop of DG grid-connected inverter on the premise of not increasing hardware cost, in order to suppress the harmonic generated by local load and SVC. For the existing SVC control method is difficult to adapt DG's characteristics of intermittent and fluctuation, the SVC voltage control strategy based on optimal recursive integral PI is put forward in the paper. The paper analyses the control stability of the system with filtering design. The intelligent and high power quality system of inverter-based distributed generation with SVC could not only provide active power, but also compensate for voltage fluctuation quickly along with eliminating harmonic produced by local load and SVC. It could further reduce the condition for distributed power connects to grid and improve the power quality of distributed generation. Simulation verifies the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: The research on the voltage sag problems in the distribution system based on the hybrid analysis method
abstract: This paper proposes a novel simulation system of the voltage sag problems in power distribution system based on the real-time monitoring data. It can improve the precision of the simulation results and reduce the number of the monitoring device needed. The overall framework of the simulation system is presented, and the method which can produce PSCAD simulation program using the database of the power supply department has been studied. The calibration principle of simulation program using real-time data has been proposed. The system function is shown through a practical example. The proposed method which combines the real-time data and simulation calculation provides good theoretical basis and technique for the research of the voltage sag problems in power distribution network.

articleTitle: The improvement and analysis of anti-mistake device of switchgear cabinet
abstract: The 10~35kV switchgear cabinet, in the current production and power system running, has been installed with the isolation baffle plate that can shield electrical part, but has not been designed to be installed with closed lock device that prevent the baffle plate opening during the checking and repairing. Therefore, the existing security measure completely depend on the personnel's security consciousness and supervision and the accident has happened. In this article, we analyze the current design disfigurement of switchgear cabinet, and hereby introduce a closed lock device that can reliably close the isolation baffle plate to prevent people incorrectly opening to touch electrical part. It not only make up the design disfigurement of anti-mistake of switchgear cabinet without changing the run operation process and affecting the, but also add the device of enforcement for the safety rule be profitable to anti-mistake, add protection for personnel safety.

articleTitle: Operation scheme for the weak structure power grid
abstract: A weak structure power grid is usually characteristic of weak structure, light load and long transmission distance. The grid of Republic of Congo is taken as an example to analyze special problems existed in the operation of such grids. Over-voltage in operation and the impact of generator integration on weak structure power system are focused. After a detailed discussion, a solving scheme was proposed. The simulation shows that the proposed scheme can ensure the safe and reliable operation of this grid; it can solve the problems existed in the parallel in of the generator. Result of this paper is also of some reference significance for solving similar problems in China.

articleTitle: The application of online temperature measurement technology in 110kV seabed cable to Changxing Island
abstract: The online temperature measurement technology in 110kV seabed cable to Changxing Island is analyzed. Since its load is on a high level for long term, especially at the seabed cable pipelining section which is the bottleneck of the circuit, the distributed fiber temperature measurement system is adopted in 110kV double-circuit seabed cable pipelining section to measure the temperature online in order to further improve the real-time monitoring level. It acquires the real-time temperature and current for the cable core temperature calculation, pre-alarm and dynamic rating calculation. When this system is put into operation, the operation data are in accordance with the real situation. The monitoring level on the seabed cable is greatly improved to provide technical base for dispatching center to handle the peak demand rating.

articleTitle: Scheme for On-Line Monitoring System based on smart converter substation
abstract: The necessity and possibility of On-Line Monitoring System (OLMS) based on smart converter substation is urged with analysis of EHV DC power grid development and the application on digital substation technology under State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC). With comments on OLMS and its application in all operating converter substations under SGCC for the time being, a solution of OLMS is actually proposed on the basis of smart converter substation development.

articleTitle: Neutral ground state and vector group of 20kV power system
abstract: With the large-scale application of 20kV power grid, unified grounding system and transformer vector grouping is critical to the economic and technical performance of the power system. The manufacturing complexity, manufacturing cost and reliability of transformer with different vector group is analyzed in this article, and the applicability of different neutral grounding state in 20kV power system is discussed.

articleTitle: New polymer insulation material in the application of clamping insulator as insulation cover
abstract: The paper presents the principle of clamping composite insulator in the application of lightning protection system. We develop a new kind of fluoroplastics material to replace the silicon rubber as insulation hood in clamping composite insulator, which improve the thermal conductivity and stain resistance that extend the service time and reliability.

articleTitle: Substation Data Validation algorithm
abstract: A basic model for Substation Data Validation is introduced and expanded. It is shown from the result that the expanded substation data validation model is more adaptive.

articleTitle: Background harmonic voltage test and evaluation
abstract: In the harmonics filed research, background harmonic voltage is always important. It is very crucial to the objectivity and rationality of the results. For example, when electric power companies distribute the harmonic voltages (currents) limit to customers, the background harmonic level of the POE should be taken into account. In the design of passive power filters, the background harmonic level of the POC should also be considered to get rational filter capacities. For the operating power grids, background harmonics can be obtained by field tests. However, due to the randomness of harmonics, it is related to the power grid structures, operating modes, load distributions etc. As a result, it is also needed to make a feasible test plan and method to get true and representative test results. For planning grids of the level year, background harmonics should be calculated and evaluated according to the existing grids. According to related national standards and referring to related IEC latest standards, this paper introduce test plans, selection criteria of test equipments, arrangement of the test time and data treatment methods etc. For the background harmonic prediction and evaluation of the level year, this paper introduces planning grids' construction, equivalent points' setting, calculation programs' selection, harmonic current sources' model and arrangement, background harmonic voltage calculation methods of the level year. This paper's research has been successfully employed in the Xiangjiaba-Shanghai Ultra-HVDC Engineering.

articleTitle: The research for network model of distribution management system
abstract: The distribution networks based specialized DMS algorithms has specific features that dominantly radial operation, very large dimensions of the system, high values of ratio of R/X parameters and reduced number of measurements. All physical entities in the distribution network are divided into objects and elements, which are connected via bays. Network Model building starts with appropriate export of data from DMS database. Based on network model function, the methodology of DMS, balanced and imbalance type network model, and the adjustment of the network model are analyzed and several aspects are researched by this topic. Finally, through the power lines network model for describing the examples. With the research of DMS network model, the system of DMS will plays a more important role in the grid production management.

articleTitle: Discussion on low-voltage transient impulse test access system
abstract: Beijing Products Quality supervision and inspection institute proposed Automotive Test Center, the programs of the test transformer substation connecting into power system have been compared in this paper. Low Voltage impulse test has shown its influence on the energy quality of the system voltage. The range of voltage sag is rested with the test capacity, the larger of the capacity the bigger of the range. PSD power system analysis software is used to simulate the transient voltage drop of the impulse test, simulation results show that the 110kV side of system bus voltage transient dropping meet the national standards in program II in which a 110kV step-down substation is built by customers.

articleTitle: The research and exploiture of subharmonic injection scheme for generator stator ground protection
abstract: With the development of the electric power industry, the number and the capacity of large generator are increasing. So more requests for the protection device of large unit are demanded in order to ensure the safety and stability of electric power system. Stator ground protection is the important part of generator and transformer protection system, and now stator ground protection is the two-frequency zero sequence voltage protection, including the basic sub-harmonic and the third sub-harmonic zero sequence voltage protection. This paper expatiates the large unit's requests for protection especially the stator ground protection. For the largening of the capacitance of the large unit, the general two-frequency zero-sequence voltage stator ground protection can not be satisfied the need, so introduce the conventional sub-harmonic injection scheme for hydro-generator stator ground protection, the drawbacks in the application are pointed out as well. Based on equilibrium principle, a new sub-harmonic injection scheme is proposed. In the protection scheme, the fault of the sub-harmonic injection, PT break and the sub-harmonic in the system are considered, and we bring forward the measure reducing basic sub-harmonic through hardware and software, including the fast arithmetic of grounded resistance base on 20 Hz and the 20Hz low-frequency signal filter channels; analysis the affect to the protection from basic sub-harmonic when grounded fault is happening; consider the affect to the precision of grounded resistance form the parameter of transformer, and give the corresponding resolving measure. Aiming at the above problem, we apply the corresponding resolving measure to protection equipment, and achieve an ideal effect in the dynamic simulation experiment and actually running.

articleTitle: Study on lightning protection of cables and transformer in Microgrid
abstract: The cable and transformer are important distribution equipment in Microgrid. Due to the low insulation level, the insulation of them is easily damaged by lightning. The models of high-frequency transformer and the calculation model of induced lightning with transmission line based on electromagnetic transient calculation software PSCAD / EMTDC are designed in this paper. The lightning protection of cables and transformer in Microgrid, the transferred overvoltage of transformer and the effect of the length of cables and the load types to overvoltage level are researched. The conclusion shows that the induced overvoltage and transferred overvoltage could be reduced efficiently after installing surge arrester at the cables and transformer, but the direct lightning overvoltage is not reduced in the safety range; The longer the cables, the lower the overvoltage is; The inductively load can reduce the overvoltage level slightly while the capacitive and resistance loads has no influence.

articleTitle: Resource management model of electric power system based on grid technology
abstract: This paper presents a resource management model of power system based on grid technology, users can use this model to structure grid management platform that provides various services, make full use of the distributed resources to process large-scale computing and simulation.

articleTitle: Study on selection theory of Shanghai 110kV power grid connection mode and its application
abstract: With the continuous development of Shanghai 110kV power grid, planners raise higher and higher demands to selecting suitable connection mode for different regions. From the characteristics of different regions in Shanghai, this paper made theoretical technical and economic study on connection modes corresponding to different 110kV power transformer capacity through establishing a reasonable mathematical model,and taking use of fuzzy quantification method of interval numbers based on trapezoidal membership function. With the method of unifying and quantifying the indicators of various regions characteristics and the grid mode characteristics, then calculating the feature matching degree, this paper gives optimal 110kV connection mode for each various region. The example of Lingang heavy equipment base in Pudong New District given in the paper shows that the given selection theory has strong practicability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Current status and application prospect of electronic transformer
abstract: This paper describes the classification of electronic transformer, configuration and main characteristics. It also introduces the development and application situation of domestic and foreign electronic transformers.

articleTitle: A method of voltage flicker estimation based on interharmonic pairs
abstract: This paper proposed a new method to estimate voltage flicker using the discrete Fourier transform (DFT). Based on the specified signal processing recommendations by IEC61000-4-7, the proposed method obtains the amplitude, frequency and phase angle of each harmonic/interharmonic using the odd points interpolation correction method. According to the electric power distortion component symbiosis mechanism, the detected interharmonics in pairs are transformed into a flicker signal. Combined with the double-side property, the interharmonics in pairs can be extracted. The parameters of flicker signal are obtained by the signal transform equations. The simulation results indicate that it is easy and quick to estimate the parameters by detecting the interharmonics signal directly and estimating the flicker signal indirectly; and the odd points interpolation correction method can separate harmonics from interharmonics effectively, and strongly restrain the spectral interruption.

articleTitle: Technical and economic characteristic analysis on 35 and 10kV Electronic Transformer
abstract: This paper describes the advantages and disadvantages of several configuration schemes for 35 and 10kV transformer in the Intelligent Substation, through technical and economic analysis, it shows that the advantages of Combined Electronic Transformers.

articleTitle: Contrast analysis of voltage deviation assessment in IEC EN and GB standards
abstract: In this paper, the measurement and assessment methods of the voltage deviation defined in the standards of International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), European Committee for Electrotechnical Standards Committee (CENELECEN) and China National standard (GB) are overviewed. The existing problems of voltage deviation assessment are discussed and analyzed in detail, combined with a case study using the proposed assessment indices in these standards. Base on the analysis and case study, the advices how to assess voltage variation disturbances are proposed for the standardization of our country on voltage deviation assessment of power quality.

articleTitle: How to solve the problems about the development and reformation of urban grid
abstract: This stage, China's power industry in large-scale new energy power generation and high voltage long distance power transmission technology keeps a world-leading position. However, the present development of high-voltage transmission, transformation and distribution system in urban area is not optimistic. According to the development experience of urban distribution network in Paris, simplify the layers of transformation of the urban distribution which are composed of only one high, medium and low voltage level. In view of this present situation of urban network in China, a new mould of high voltage packaged and intelligent substation scheme has been advanced to complete the difficult problems of urban grid development and reformation.

articleTitle: System reliability, safety and quality
abstract: As technology and economic development, the requirements of community power quality, continuity and reliability are increasing. Contradiction between supply and demand will become more and more prominent. Power distribution system is an important part of the user connection. It is directly related electrical safety and reliability to the user. At present 10 kV Substation is and implementation of power facilities, it undertakes the important task of the city power supply. Therefore, increasing the reliability is an important power enterprises comprehensive work of sustainable development. We must analysis the reliability of power supply which existed in the 10 kV Substation. And to seek the methods and the measures of improving power supply reliability. Starting from the factors which affecting the supply reliability, we expand equipment, operations, computer-based surveillance, communications local area network, optical technology, operation and management in four aspects of intelligence

articleTitle: Transmission network expansion planning under interval load
abstract: The transmission network expansion planning model under interval load is built. This model considers the load uncertainty. Its objective is the minimum of investment and its constraints are the network safety under both normal and NȒ1 conditions. The interval minimum load cutting theory is used and the interval maximum load cutting number is calculated to judge the safety of transmission expansion planning scheme under interval load. The greedy randomized adaptive search procedure algorithm (GRASP) is used to solve the model. The 6-bus and 77-bus system cases prove the rightness and validity of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: The research of distribution network communication method
abstract: Distribution network automation is aiming at improving the reliability of power supply, ameliorating the power quality and improving the operate management efficiency. However, all kinds of technology are developing continuously, but one key element to improve the level of distribution network automation is to choose the reasonable, reliable, economic communication method. This issue analyze some kinds of commonly communication method, and compare them about reliability, timeliness and economic efficiency etc. Through the analysis, the method that using mobile wireless network is obviously worthy application.

articleTitle: High voltage distribution network planning based on integrated model
abstract: This paper describes a new method for urban high-voltage distribution network planning required by environmental and practical needs. In the traditional network planning, the index system of environmental protection is composed of indices related to radiation, land occupation and environmental compatibility. This paper adds electrical source line index, then model the power line, builds an integrated model. Then take a certain region network as an example to calculate the new model. The planning results show that the new method can influence the planning scheme macroscopically and make it more practicability-friendly.

articleTitle: Analysis on arc generation mechanism and efficient clearing method of conductive filaments
abstract: Analysis and experimental research on the phenomenon and mechanism of arc generation between two phases of power system were carried out. Four physical effects which resulted in the generation of electric arc were described. The clearing characteristics of general conductive filaments were analyzed. The efficient filaments clearing methods were explored. The research results are helpful for the power system to recover the electricity distribution capability rapidly after the attack of graphite bombs.

articleTitle: Analysis and prevention of trips caused by bushfire
abstract: The long last of bushfire, causing the failure of transmission lines' reclosing, repeated trips or failure to rework in a short time, severely threatens power system's safety and stability. After analysing several trips caused by bushfire and learning from CSG's long-term anti-bushfire work experience, this paper summarizes the harms of bushfire as well as some problems that exist in the present anti-bushfire work for transmission lines. Besides, this paper analyses how bushfire causes transmission line trips by the help of live fault tracks, and finds the paths through which transmission lines discharge when trips happen. Moreover, suggestions for the prevention from trips caused by bushfire are also listed in the paper.

articleTitle: The research and practice of high voltage cubicle early warning based on Gas Component Analysis
abstract: The monitoring of heat generation inside closed high-voltage switch cabinet is a technical problem which affects safe production at present. This paper analyses the present early warning technique for switch cabinet at home and abroad and proposes the high-voltage switch cabinet elements based on gas composition analysis, and deeply analyses the principle of temperature measurement using laser light scattering. This paper introduces the structure of high-voltage switch cabinet early warning device based on gas composition analysis which has run into operation and the function of each module. Meanwhile, this paper summarizes achievements and prospects the next major research.

articleTitle: Research on underground power planning based virtual reality
abstract: With the development of city, the planning of underground power pipelines becomes more and more difficult, because pipelines are invisible and related with many factors. In order to improve planning efficiencies, a new technique based on virtual reality is presented. A virtual scene is constructed according to the existing pipeline and related environment. And the area partition method is introduced to increase rendering speed. So the designer can browse the virtual underground space at their choice. It makes the planning work simple. Then, a planning drawing and a three-dimensional demonstration will be automatically produced on the basis of the planning message.

articleTitle: Research on the power transmission and distribution cost model of the allocation wholesale electricity business at a provincial level
abstract: During the process of the wholesale, in different power grid gate, the wholesale power capacity requires different provincial power network lines and different usages of the resources of the transformation of electric energy; hence it has some influences on the cost of power transmission and distribution which was operated by the provincial power company who allocated the wholesale power correlated. Focused on the different power grid gate of the wholesale, the thesis is going to construct an allocated cost model of the power transmission and distribution, and points out the fact reasonably and faithfully that how the utilization of the transformation of the electric energy resources was affected by the wholesale power business, therefore, it promotes the harmonious development of all levels of networks and forms the reasonable price mechanism of the power transmission and distribution and meanwhile the price mechanism of the wholesale power business.

articleTitle: Research on a fault diagnosis method for power distribution grids
abstract: The variation of the amplitude of neutral voltage can tell no more information than the existence of a grounded fault in power distribution grids. To solve this problem, a method that is capable of diagnosing the type and phase of fault are proposed in this paper on the basis of the three criteria after theoretical analysis on different fault models. Relative simulation works on MATLAB provided the verification for this method.

articleTitle: Implementation of the interface to electronic transducer in digital substation
abstract: The application of electronic current/voltage transducers is of great significance in improving the reliability of power systems and especially protection relays. However the interface between the electronic transducers and bay devices is the focus of digital substation. In this paper, merging unit, the key element of the interface, is introduced and its function model is discussed. Considering the communication characteristic of the interface, i.e. multi-task has to be dealt with in parallel, a new FPGA-based method for realizing the interface to electronic transducers is also proposed in this paper. By using FPGA, the merging unit can receive the sampled values from several electronic transducers and check the corresponding validity simultaneously. Moreover, these sampled values can be ordered correctly via FPGA FIFO before they are transmitted. The suggested method has practical values for promoting the application of electronic transducers into the digital substation.

articleTitle: Identification of key lines in complex power grid based on power flow entropy
abstract: In most cases, large scale blackouts are due to the successive malfunction of a large number of components often triggered by an initial disturbance or event, such as short circuits of transmission lines, protection device misoperation and bad weather. But analyses of these blackouts also show that not all the initial disturbances could lead to major cascading failures. The scale of a cascading failure could be influenced by the firstly tripped line which trips out firstly after the initial disturbance. For most of the lines in a complex power grid, when they act as the firstly tripped line, cascading failures stop quickly and could not proceed to a large scale. But for some lines, referred to as key lines in this paper, when they act as the firstly tripped line, cascading failures could cause many lines trip out progressively. In this paper, we propose a method for identification of key lines in complex power grid base on the new concept of power flow entropy.

articleTitle: Discussion of the testing technology for protection device used in digital substation
abstract: The protection relays used in digital substation (called digital protection device) are different from traditional micr-computer based relays in both hardware and signal processing, and traditional relay testing methods are no ever adaptable to such new type of relays. This article analyzed the testing requirement of digital protection devices and several available testing schemes, introduced the function test method and the conformance test method of digital protection devices in laboratory. At the same time, the configuration method and testing schemes of digital relay testing instrument are introduced in detail based on engineering test practice of digital protection devices, and the deficiency in nowadays test methods was also analyzed. This paper proposed an idea that laboratory test method combined with engineering test method in relays testing, and which was a valuable exploration on the development of digital protection testing technology.

articleTitle: Development and application of distribution network comprehensive analysis system
abstract: Through a system study of the fundamental theories of distribution network analysis, operation optimization and network architecture assessment, including static security analysis theory, power flow calculation method, state estimation technique, network optimization method, fault isolation and recovery algorithm, and reactive power optimization algorithm, etc, a graphic distribution network analysis system was developed. Feeder renovation and sectionalization is determined by using the “User Loss Vs Load Loss” charts with both economy and reliability taken into consideration. Interpolation method is used to work out an optimal reactive power compensation capacity, enhancing computational speed. Vector data layering and blocking technique increases the processing speed of the graphic system. The system has been applied in over ten power utilities, and proved effective and helpful.

articleTitle: Harmonic suppression and reactive control of NQ station in Genan HVDC system
abstract: This article has analyzed the origin and the harm of harmonics in the HVDC system. The harmonics analysis has been done to the DC and AC side of NQ substation in Ge-Nan HVDC system. And found the order 13 harmonic filters capacities are insufficient, so DA32 capacitor group will be transformed into HP11.8 filter. The reactive power control method of NQ station is also introduced in this paper, especially Umax, Q-control and Qmax control algorithms. The tests validated the AC filter switching sequence. The reason of F1 group filters must be devoted firstly before the HVDC system starts is analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of wind farm reactive power and voltage problems based on detailed model
abstract: With the scale of wind power connected to the main grid continuing to expand, reactive power and voltage problems of the wind farm are attracting more and more attention. In this paper, two electrical microscopic models are separately built which are based on two typical grid-connected wind farms combined the actual condition of Jiangsu grid in summer 2009, and the paper also carries on the simulations with the PSASP tool. The reactive power variation of wind farms is studied according to the simulation results. Meanwhile, the simulation results is compared with the statistical data of the power quality monitoring system, the two results are almost the same, which prove the models are reasonable.

articleTitle: Research and application of the fault information integration and intelligent analysis in distributed grid
abstract: In recent years, to build smart grid becomes a new focus, and how to fully collect and make effective use of the information of the intelligent secondary device get abroad attention. This paper presents a grid fault information intelligent analysis and processing system. It is a platform of fault information intelligent processing, used for an incorporate control center system of province and district level. It works in two parts, substation and control center. In the substation, a slave system device gather the information of relays and deliver it to the master system in the control center through Ethernet, and a recorder proxy device gather the information of recorders and deliver it to the master system through another Ethernet channel. The software in the control center has a layered and distributed structure, and import the information of relays and recorders with two isolated server in the data layer. The application layer of the software system can gather the information to a integrated report of a grid disturbance or fault with special process, include of using the fault index,fault time, etc. This method is effective of reduce the requirement of the hardware resource of the slave system, and can decrease the chance of Ethernet block. It can support the decision of the dispatcher and fleetly deal the gird fault. This system has been used in the control center of Taizhou district in Zhejiang province, and remarkably improves the level of management. The system is programmed to integrate with information of other systems, such as SCADA and EMS, and will get whole view of the grid information to give stronger support of building a smart grid.

articleTitle: Updated distance protection makes distribution network more intelligent
abstract: As the finish of national distribution network updating, the national distribution network situation is going to be better. There are more single phase grounding faults than interphase short circuit faults. But the general used current protection equipment, which only reflects the interphase short circuit, cannot reflect grounding fault. And the distribution network is getting more complex. So the currency protection,which is affected by operating mode, cannot cater the selectivity and sensitivity requirement of protection. The updated distance protection can not only reflect the grounding fault in distribution network but also would not be affected by the system operating mode. So it can cater the selectivity and sensitivity requirement of protection very well. And it makes the city distribution network more reliable.

articleTitle: The design and realization of distribution network pre-arranged Plans automatic generation system based on chart-module integration
abstract: The paper analyzed the characters of distribution network and the role of the distribution network pre-arranged plans. It pointed out the importance of the distribution network pre-arranged plans in the supervisory control and management. Based on this character, it proposed a suit of distribution network pre-arranged plans automatic generation system which is built on graph support system and distribution network foundation information can be included. This system gives the search path in distribution network legibly through the best of graph visualization technique. It can liberate the operators from the magnanimity data.

articleTitle: Damping subsynchronous oscillation by static VAR compensator
abstract: Because of large-capacity, long-distance and cross-region power transmission in our country's power grid, the subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) will arise from the use of series capacitor compensation and HVDC. Damping subsynchronous oscillation using static VAR compensators (SVC) is investigated in this paper. In order to damp the various unstable torsional modes, a subsynchronous damping controller is designed according to the phase compensation methods. Eigenvalue analysis of the closed-loop system and test signal method reveal that this controller is quite effective. The time domain simulations are also performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller under disturbance condition.

articleTitle: Full-scale test and research on transmission tower for UHV AC test and pilot Project
abstract: It's the first used in 1000kV Transmission Line in China. To verify the validity of optimize, calculate and select material in UHV AC test and pilot project tower, choose several typical towers to conduct test and research. This article Through analyze the test data, it provides optimize proposal, reference for UHV tower design.

Author Keywords: UHV AC Test and pilot Project

articleTitle: Testing system research based on virtual electricity meter software
abstract: With the further construction of smart grid by State Grid, demand for measuring equipment including smart electricity meter and acquisition terminal certainly will increase. In this paper, a new testing system based on virtual meter is proposed, contraposing weakness in the function testing equipment and consistency test. Conveniently, it can bring power enterprises automation and reliability of testing improvement, lower the cost, and help manufacturers to promote products. Through researching for the system, we find that it can effectively improve each equipment testing of the user information acquisition system, provide power enterprise effective means of testing conformance to protocols and detecting function under laboratory conditions, and support electric information acquisition system staunch technology.

articleTitle: The research and development of comprehensive evaluation and management system for harmonic and negative-sequence
abstract: Power quality interference sources generate a large number of harmonics and negative-sequence current into power grid in the process of using electricity. Harmonics and negative-sequence current not only affect power grid's safety and economical operation also cause interference to other normal users, which brings large threat and danger to the power grid and users. As an effective method to prevent and control power quality interference source, it is important to evaluate the harmonic and negative-sequence current at the installation part of power quality interference source, guide the user taking measures to control power quality in the design of current electricity-consummation. This paper describes the research and development of comprehensive evaluation and management system for harmonic and negative-sequence current. This software has the following functions: harmonic computation, comprehensive assessment of user harmonic and negative-sequence, filter design and checking, SVC measurement, harmonic source database management. This software models the system components, load and typical harmonic source under the CIGRE standard with graphical interface. It models the power supply network by the means of one-line diagram, completes the harmonic calculation by Monte-Carlo or Laguerre polynomial, and simulates the distribution of power system harmonics by statistical moment with harmonics power flow techniques. The evaluation of user's harmonic and negative-sequence based mainly on the GB, combined with the access point short-circuit capacity, power capacity and protocol capacity to calculate the limit value of harmonic and negative-sequence current that assigned to user. According to the typical user's harmonic emission level or measured value, we can calculate the value of harmonic current generated by user and execute assessment by comparing them. One way to design filter and carry on SVC evaluation is calculating by custom method. Another way is to cut the existing data into calculation and checking, and then the bus voltage waveform before and after inputting filter or SVC by graphical virtual operation can be obtained, and a rich and intuitive results reports and graphics can be generated at the same time. This software is easy to operate, and its calculation results are accurate. It is an effective tool to assess and manage power quality.

articleTitle: Application research of laser gas detection technology in the analysis of sulphur hexafluoride
abstract: The decision of latent fault in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas electrical equipment can be made more timely and accurately through online monitoring of content change of HF, one of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas decomposition. Tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopic (TDLAS) technology applies the wavelength tunable characteristics of diode lasers to gain the absorption spectroscopy of the selected absorption line of the target gas for the qualitative or quantitative analysis of the target gas. Because of its high sensitivity, high selectivity, short response time and without cross-interference, etc., we can achieve online monitoring and make the detection of HF more direct, accurate and timely through installing the technical equipment in the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> electrical equipment monitoring site location. The analysis shows that the TDLAS technology is an effective and reliable method of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> online monitoring technique.

articleTitle: An experience of on-site PD testing for condition monitoring of an 11kV PILC cable insulation systems
abstract: A cable circuit of a substation in the United Kingdom showed high level of PD activities during a survey using hand hold PD testing equipment. The present authors were invited to carry out on-site PD testing experiment to further diagnose and locate the potential problem of the cable system. This paper presents the experience of the present authors carrying out the cable test. Following a brief introduction to the experiment equipments and physical connections, the paper analyses the data collected from the testing, including PD pulse shape analysis, frequency spectrum analysis, phase resolved PD pattern analysis. Associated with PD propagation direction identification, PD source diagnosis and localisation was made. Four different types of sensors, which were adapted during the testing, are shown to have different frequency bandwidths and performed differently. After comparing the parameters of the sensor and the PD signals detected by individual sensor, optimal PD monitoring bandwidth for cable system is suggested.

articleTitle: Hanging the ending at 60∼90 degree corner upper 10kv lines
abstract: The development and implementation of this project has successfully achieved that the live working can implement on the 60∼90 degree corner unit where elevated car can reach. Power Supply Company can improve power supply reliability, and has very positive implications in electricity sales, while improving the social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Two methods of data synchronization in optical fiber differential: Improved interpolation and clock relay
abstract: This paper designed two data synchronization methods in optical fiber differential protection connected with electronic transformers, improved interpolation and clock relay. The first can solve perfectly the data synchronization problem where the MU connected with differential protection according with IEC 60044-8 interface, the second can solve the problem where the MU connected protection device according with IEC 61850-9.The first needs the ET transfer delays at two sides as setting values, the second not. The two methods get rid of GPS recommended connotatively by the standard and improve protection's reliability greatly; They don't adjust the sampling time, accords with the function and frame condition ordained in standard IEC 60044-8 and can be applied flexibly to the case that one side connected with ET and one side connected with traditional transformer. In addition, the paper proposes the logic and application method that the MU transmits or self-produces the 1pps signal shared by protection and the MU. The method further improves the reliability of the protection and ensure the protect function independent of any other devices except the MU and protection.

articleTitle: Analysis on active output characteristics of wind farms in concentrated areas of wind power
abstract: In comparatively concentrated areas of wind farms, the active output curves of the wind farms take on some similarity due to the closeness of those farms and their identical wind conditions. Therefore the study of active output characteristics of wind farms is significant for the dispatching operation of electric grids. This paper, based on the real measured data of the active output from Jiangsu EMS system, gives detailed analysis of the active output from different wind farms in coastal area of Jiangsu Province, and investigates the correlation and fluctuation of active output among different wind farms and the impact of its characteristics on grids.

articleTitle: Simulation study on converter transformer saturation characteristics due to GIC
abstract: The converter transformer saturation model founded in the paper is based on UMEC (Unified Magnetic Equivalent Circuit) theory, which considers core flux and leakage flux uniformly, with high simulation accuracy. Based on the model founded, detailed simulations are made about the converter transformer magnetizing current, the harmonic characteristics of the primary-side and secondary-side current of the converter transformer and the reactive power characteristics by PSCAD simulation software. Finally, this paper presents some cure strategies to inhibit converter transformer DC bias.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of trading for different objective in Shanghai power grid considering demand side participation
abstract: It is real-time interaction in the electrical characteristics between purchasing side and selling side of power grid, those two balanced at any time scales. So power optimization is a problem that is essentially overall optimization of transaction of purchasing and selling electricity. Trading patterns will change with fluctuations of demand-side response introduced in power market, mainly in trade diversified options in optimization objectives. The paper formulated series of problems of optimization on the electricity purchasing and selling, analysed the existing shortage of electricity trading models and study great theoretical significance and practical engineering value of the efficient, economic, and environmental protection operations in electricity trading on the Shanghai grid future electricity market with the demand-side participation. According to Shanghai electrical network actual data (various time intervals electric quantity of 6 professions and 8 power plants), models were separately found from different objectives based on the transaction benefit to highest, the accumulation benefit of trade transmission losses to be most superior and the effect of energy saving and emission reducing to most optimal. Trading volume and income were obtained in various time intervals of various models of various industries and power plants, as well as the most superior trading distribution in different electricity price adjustment after the demand elastic response in Shanghai power grid. It is proved the model accuracy and the objectivity. The article integrated the demand characteristic into the electric trading, which is closer to the essence of power market, to take a research respond of power market and provide the technical support of the linkage between purchasing and selling electricity side in power market.

articleTitle: Grounding design of electric power plants and transformer substations in high soil resistivity area
abstract: This paper discusses current grounding design issues of present electric power plants, transformer substations in high soil resistivity area, by incorporating the actual engineering data of a 220KV substation, analyzes the impact degree of grounding design parameters to earth potential, contact potential, and step potential. It also can be used as a reference point for peers to discuss in engineering design.

articleTitle: Analysis of the phenomenon of false ground in small current grounding system
abstract: Through discussion of the process of live apart and lap of the outlet cable, this paper provides a detailed numerical analysis of the live working. During the live working, ground signal in the substation is a false grounding caused by the change of capacitance to ground of the network.

articleTitle: Research on power quality monitoring and analyzing system based on embedded technology
abstract: Based on actual problems in power industry, a power quality on-line monitoring system was set up by comprehensively adopting embedded technology of software and hardware platform, GIS (Geographic Information System) information technology and Internet technology. Meanwhile analyzing methods of time domain, frequency domain and mixed domain were used in this system to monitor, evaluate and analyze all monitoring data, which realizes the evaluation of power system reliability index and thereby continuously improves power system reliability and then plays an active role on enhancing the power quality level of power system in Henan province.

articleTitle: Intelligent optimization algorithm for the locating and sizing of distributed generation planning
abstract: This paper analyses the influence of network loss when distribution generation (DG) access to distribution network, and presents an intelligent optimization algorithm to optimize the locating and sizing of DG based on modified particle swarm optimal (PSO) algorithm. The purposed algorithm is to find how much distribution network loss can be further reduced. With an example the superiority of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated in comparison with the genetic algorithms. The calculation results show that the proposed algorithm to solve the problem of distributed generation planning has strong global search ability and rapid convergence speed.

articleTitle: Application comparison of Rogowski-type and optical-type electronic current transformer
abstract: This paper aims at analysis and comparison of the features of Rogowski-type and optical-type electronic current transformers(ECT). Referring the application results of digital substation in operation, it analyses engineering application, theory and reality combined, their advantages and disadvantages and summarizes experience in the application, providing reference for the application and research of ECT.

articleTitle: Research on the method to restrain the corona happened in switch cubicle
abstract: Switch cubicle has been widely used in switchgear substation and switchgear house. However, the switch cubic accidents are greater due to various causes. Further more, the single accident would damage other switch cubicles, because of its special assembling. Some accidents caused by insulation problem happened in our power supply company. And the corona happened inner the switch cubicle was found, when its working. The corona happened mainly in the gap between the organic insulation material and iron plate, and near the flange of bushing. The reason, which would lead to discharge, was analyzed in this paper. The research results show that electrical field concentrate on the gap between the organic insulation material and iron plate. Therefore discharge would happen at this place firstly. An experimental system was set up to analyze this discharge. In the experimental system, the ultraviolet-imaging instrument was used to locate the discharge position, and the partial discharge instrument was used to show the magnitude of discharge. Based on the research, a new way was pointed out to avoid corona, that a kind of semiconducting material was used to fill the gap. And the validity of this way was testified by the experiment and practice. Some proposal also was presented to the equipments manufactory. Some improvements should be adopted in the design, such as using shielding ring and conducting flange.

articleTitle: Discussion on the planning and optimization strategies of MV distribution network in typical districts of cities
abstract: Main connection modes of MV distribution network and their applicable conditions in Shanghai are introduced first. Supply ability, reliability level and economical efficiency of each mode are analyzed in detail. Connection modes of typical districts are recommended combined with the regional characteristics. On the basis of the above analysis, two examples: typical residential districts in towns and central regions under progress of overhead lines reformation, are given in the end of the paper to show the strategies of planning and optimization of the distribution network in typical districts of cities.

articleTitle: Studies on the influence of loads on voltage stability in the urban power grid
abstract: Loads in the urban power grid are complex. Dynamic loads with large-capacity have great effect on voltage stability of the urban power grid. Load models are established with statistical synthesis. Simulations show the conservativeness of static model. Then, simulations and analysis are done based on dynamic integrated load model in the case of different load compositions, different fault locations and different fault clearing times. The results show that large proportion of rotating load, short distance between fault and external equivalent source and long fault standing time will make negative effect on voltage stability of the urban power grid.

articleTitle: The wind-power converting system design with application of model Hamiltonian controller
abstract: Based on Hamiltonian energy theory, this paper proposes a pitch angle and excitation torque controller for the wind energy conversion systems (WECS), such that the closed-loop system can achieve its stability. Furthermore, in the presence of disturbances, the closed-loop system is finite-gain L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> stable by the Hamiltonian controller. The Hamiltonian energy approach provides us a physical insight and gives a new way to the controller design. The simulations are illustrated to show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on doubly-fed wind power generator modeling
abstract: Doubly-fed induction generator(DFIG) is obtaining more and more applications in wind power due to it's high energy efficient and controllable reactive power. In this paper, the maximum power capturing and the process of energy conversion is introduced. And the mathematic model under the two-phase synchronous coordinator is deduced. Based on stator flux orientation, the active and reactive power decoupled control strategy is deduced. The simulation results reveals that the model built in MATLAB can achieve the aim of wind power tracing and decoupled control.

articleTitle: The research on loss allocation methods in electricity market
abstract: With the development of global innovation in electric power market, transmission system will ultimately be an independent part of the market transaction. Transmission loss cost allocation is an important constitution of transmission tariff, different loss allocation method will affect economic benefit and trade enthusiasm of each market member, so loss allocation problem is desired to settle in electric power market. In this paper, it firstly introduced several familiar loss calculation methods The paper researched on loss allocation, according to the compared results, made out some common problems exist in loss allocation methods, then spent lots time and energy in researching on power flow tracing method.

articleTitle: Validity analysis of prony algorithm on faulty feeder selection in distribution grids
abstract: When a single-phase earthed fault occurred in distribution grids, power system variables during transient process are composed of damped DC components and damped AC components (fundamental wave and harmonics). Prony algorithm can directly estimate the magnitude, phase, frequency and damping factor of all modes which damp exponentially. Such algorithm is more suitable to the character of power system transient variables and can produce high-accuracy fitting by least-square means. A simulation model of non-effectively earthed distribution grid is established and vast simulations under diverse fault conditions have been done. Prony fitting of ATP simulation data of single-phase earthed fault and the field fault data are analyzed by using Prony algorithm respectively, which all proved that the validity of Prony algorithm on faulty feeder selection in distribution grids.

articleTitle: Research of distributed photovoltaic power supply access simultaneous power quality monitoring system
abstract: Using the technology of WAN Sync measurement based the GPS, this paper proposes a simultaneous power quality monitoring system applying to the characteristic of the photovoltaic in order to solve the power quality problem causing by the technology of distributed solar energy power accessing to the power distribution network. The system can be used to get the simultaneous monitoring data of the photovoltaic power accessing point. Indicators of the power quality can be analyzed by the central visual software platform. The result of the analysis is the basis for the problem of the power quality.

articleTitle: Research of flexible wide-area measurement and analysis system in power system
abstract: Based on the wide area measurement system (WAMS), this article proposes Research of flexible wide-area measurement and analysis system in power system(Flexible Wide Area Measurement System, FWAMS). The system can flexible layout several interim measurement points in local Network, and access to Flexible Phasor Measurement Unit (FPMU), According to different time periods and different needs flexible build wide-area synchronized measurement network respectively, Measure the system state. We can use the limited measurement devices measure the whole network state “quasi-total coverage”, it can effectively overcome the shortcomings of the fixed network mode of the monitoring system.

Author Keywords: flexible wide area measurement system (FW MS)

articleTitle: Research on final voltage of VRLA 50% rated capacity discharge in substation
abstract: The real capacity of valve-regulated lead acid battery (VRLA) determines reliability of direct current (DC) power system directly. The 50% rated capacity discharge testing in this paper is based on full capacity discharge method and its final voltage is obtained according to build and analyse mathematical model. Compare to full capacity discharge, this method can settle long time discharge and low safety for single-group batteries in transformer substation effectively.

articleTitle: Studies and discussions of smart terminal for electric utilization
abstract: In the first, a simple analysis is done for related technology about smart grid and smart electric utilization. Secondly, the paper describes definition, scope, technical demand of smart terminals. Based on analysis of requirements, principle and structure of smart terminal is presented, and function of terminal is discussed in detail. Finally, the trends of technology for smart electric terminal is expected.

articleTitle: The application of CPU card in the electricity sales management
abstract: As the information exchange media between electric meters and electricity sales systems, the smart card solves the recovery problems of electric bill. This paper in detail describes the process of CPU card in the pre-paid electricity sales management system and key management system. And from the standpoint of CPU card file structure, it puts forward the way of a multi-purpose card, avoiding the repeated production and distribution, reducing the burden of electricity sales management, and giving great convenience to users.

articleTitle: Introduction of security assessment system based on grid technology in power network
abstract: Grid technology is one of new distributed computing technology. It is suitable for solving the problem of massive date, huge information, complex models and large calculation. It is an effective way to make power system operate safe by combining grid technology with supervision technology in power system. Brief introduction and research of security assessment system is proposed in this paper. The architecture of security assessment system is indicated also.

articleTitle: Application of solid insulated materials on medium voltage switchgear of distribution lines
abstract: For medium voltage and high voltage class, SF6 gases are widely used for insulating materials for most of the switchgears at distribution lines because of its superior electrical insulating quality. However, this SF6 gas belongs to one of 6 greenhouse gases which have to be reduced each year by complying with the Kyoto's protocol signed in 1997. So many researches are made by power equipment companies for the purpose of finding out appropriate alternative material for SF6 gas. Recently, epoxy is proved to be a high insulation reliability and eco-friendly used on electrical equipments. This paper introduces a kind of epoxy molded Solid Insulated Switchgear (SIS) for medium voltage class.

articleTitle: Analysis and management research on the impact of Shanghai-Nanjing intercity railway traction load on power grid
abstract: With the rapid development of the Highspeed electrified railway in China, the traction load has an increasingly high proportion of the power load. Because of the specificity of traction load, its power factor is low , in contrary its concomitant harmonics and negative sequence currents generally exceed standard and impair the power quality seriously. This paper analyses four aspects, including traction transformer connection,traction substation power supply mode,power supply voltage level and traction load power quality improvement. Finally, choose the best solution by comparing these options to each other and considering the practical application.

articleTitle: The analysis of Electronic Arc Suppression Coil on transient signals method in non-solidly earthed network
abstract: A single phase to earth fault model of the Peterson coil compensated network is established in this paper. The transient characteristics of Electronic Arc Suppression Coil are analyzed. This paper emphasizes on the effect of electronic arc suppression coil in transient signals method. And the reliability of earthed line protection between amplitude method and polarity comparison method in different transition resistance are analyzed.

articleTitle: Medium-voltage Distribution Feeder model and network topology
abstract: Some of the inherent features of electric distribution systems are that the system includes an extremely large number of equipments and few links between different feeders. Based on these features, a network topology algorithm feeder oriented is proposed in this paper. A Circuit is a collection of conducting equipments, branch-circuits, and pole-mounted switches and is divided into a number of feeder segments by section switches. A Circuit generally starts with a switching device, located in a substation to an open switch (radial circuit), or to a second substation (ring circuit). It proposes modified models for distribution lines such as Ring, Circuit, and Circuit Section based on the IEC 61968/61970 CIM model. Using these models, topology processing is divided into three steps: feeder Analysis, ring analysis, and network analysis.

articleTitle: The influence of low resistance grounding system in delta side of transformer on differential protection and its solutions
abstract: In the system with lead in delta side of transformer grounded by low resistance, differential current arises in the traditional differential protection when having grounding fault beyond protected zone in this side, which may cause differential protection mal-operation. The paper analyzes the two schemes by contrast. The first scheme is differential protection zero sequence elimination in delta side and the other is setting differential threshold value higher than the maximal ground fault zero sequence current. According to the study, the first scheme eliminates the unbalanced differential current effectively when having grounding fault beyond protected zone in delta side, and improves the reliability of differential protection greatly. For the transformer with the voltage of 35kV in delta side, the first scheme lowers the differential threshold value and improves the sensitivity of differential protection when having single-phase grounding fault in protected zone. For the transformer with the voltage of 10kV (or 20kV) in delta side, none of these two schemes can reflect the single-phase grounding fault in protected zone sensitively.

articleTitle: Research in the distribution generation of the random power output characteristics influence on the distribution network reliability
abstract: The paper builds the reliability evaluation model of distribution generation with the random power output characteristics, based on island operating mode, analyses how to calculate the island probability, then combined with proposed method of literature, obtains the distribution network reliability index considering distribution generation with the random power output characteristics. Finally the imitation and calculation of IEEE-RBTS Bus6 demonstrate the efficiency and practicability of the proposed calculating mode.

articleTitle: Random-neighbor-search based optimal planning for distribution networks with wind power
abstract: With the continuous effort of exploiting wind energy, a higher penetration of wind power will be integrated into networks in the form of distributed generation. In order to well plan the integration of wind power and the network, the randomness of wind power as well as its influence to the whole distribution networks should be considered. As a result, traditional optimal planning approach for distribution networks should be modified and supplemented. In the first part of the paper, a detailed analysis for wind power characteristic and its influence to distribution network planning were discussed. In the second part, through variation of sampling wind power and load, the chance-constrained model of distribution networks was introduced. At last, an improved algorithm based on random-neighbour-search was proposed to implement optimal planning for distributional network structure. The results of case study show the feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An effective and applied method on evaluation of distribution network planning
abstract: Planning is vital for the development of power system; and the quality of planning has direct influence on security, reliability and economy of the power system in the future. Therefore, it is urgently needed to study quantitative evaluation method for distribution network planning. Firstly, this paper proposes a practical comprehensive hierarchy and method on evaluation of distribution network planning. Secondly, the implementation steps for the evaluation of planning network are given, which include the determination of indices hierarchy and the evaluation of planning. In the end, this paper takes 10kV network distribution planning of a district in China for example in order to illustrate the specific evaluation steps and methods based on the hierarchy, at the same time, the case shows that the evaluation method has strong feasibility and practicability. The planning evaluation hierarchy and method proposed in this paper can not only seize the key elements influencing the characteristics of network planning, but also describe the planning integrally and quantitatively, and possess significant engineering practicability.

articleTitle: Research on pareto optimal-based delamination and partition-area program of Hebei Southern Power Grid
abstract: With the voltage level of the power grid upgrading, the existing of the electromagnetic loop network may be not propitious for security and stability of power system. This paper analyzes the coupled electromagnetic loop network operation issues of Hebei southern power grid, checks the decoupled program proposed by the “11th Five-Year Plan”, and optimization of the program based on the concept of Pareto. The final recommendations are given.

articleTitle: The study and manufacture of the XD® serials of adsorbent and it's efficiency of the transformer oil treatment for a EHV transformer
abstract: In this paper, the development process of XD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> series adsorbent is briefly introduced, the distinction is characterized between different adsorbent; explored the use of adsorbent and sorption properties; found the relationship between its physical-chemical properties and its regenerative properties in electric oil; expound the superior performance on transformer oil regeneration; finally introduce XD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> series of adsorbent to deal with the practical application on large transformer practically. By the component analysis of transformer oil before and after the oil treatment, As well as the nine-year running of a EHV transformer, prove the reliability of the technology of raising the transformer insulation lever by oil treatment.

articleTitle: The research and design of wireless communication system for substation
abstract: Along with the advancing of intelligent grid construction, the information access inside substations has become increasingly flexible, and traditional in-substation wire communication could not meet such demand any longer. Through comparative analysis on the transmission bandwidth, QOS, reliability and safety of various wireless communication techniques in common use at present, and with IEEE802.11 (Wi-Fi) as in-substation wireless communication method and Mesh as networking technology, this paper has designed a set of whole-substation-through wireless communication systems. Such systems could realize overall coverage of communication in substations, make it convenient for the seamless access and interconnection of different communication equipments, and materialize the plug and play of communication equipments. In addition, in the electromagnetic environment of some 220kV substation in Nanjing, and based on the experiment and computational analysis on the anti-electromagnetic interference ability of secondary equipment in the substation, this paper has determined the feasibility of substation wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and suggestions of several malfunctions based on SF6 GIS facilities in capital construction or operation
abstract: SF6 electrical facilities malfunction contains these types: Forced fault (discharging channels mostly related to solid insulation, electric insulation cannot recover after high-energy discharge) and flexible fault (discharging channels mostly related to SF6 gas insulation or the combination of gas insulation and solid insulation, electric insulation recovers after high-energy discharge). Character of SF6 electrical facilities malfunctions can be determined by means of SO2 and H2S fast-local-detection. This essay expatiate on SF6 electrical facilities discharging malfunctions, including estimation evidence, type, part, and discharging current. Through conventional and unconventional chemical, electrical test instruments, through investigation on solid powder, gas composition and chemical materials in GIS SF6 CT gas chamber before and after the flashover fault, it comes to the conclusion that inner CT with frequent flashover fault contains nitrile butadiene rubber board. The corrosive sulfur reacting with the contact part plating silver produces silver sulfide. It forms the discharging channel finally, which causes the arc-over in the CT chamber.

articleTitle: Based on the problems of extra(ultra) high substation digitalization and smart grid
abstract: Optical digital substation protection equipment on-site debugging technology, Energy Measurement, Conformance Test Platform is the key for extra(ultra) high-voltage substation to digitize and achieve smart grid. Achieved with the optical sensor applications in research breakthroughs, IEC 61850 standards promulgated, so network communication technology and the development of intelligent circuit breaker, digital has become the mainstream of the development of substation automation technology. As the number of substations in the network communication is very complex, it is necessary to its products and systems for conformance testing of communication behavior. Testing three different devices is to ensure the interoperability. That interoperability for communications services is to obtain the basis for functional interoperability, and for functional testing and engineering applications more closely. For the future of Digital Optical transformer substation in the electric energy measurement and energy measurement of the difference between the traditional influence and the characteristics of the secondary circuit are introduced, and debug digital protection scheme, the entire group and network transmission time of the test methods and existing Some common problems and put forward his point of view.

articleTitle: Control strategy of shunt hybrid active power filter in distribution network containing distributed power
abstract: For continuous applications of distributed power, such as photovoltaic power and wind power and so on, power quality of public distribution network faced more uncertain factors, performance of power quality compensation equipments in distribution network like shunt hybrid active power filter (SHAPF) also suffered from some negative influences of distributed power, so their control strategies were required more. To maintain satisfied compensation performance of SHAPF even after applications of distributed generation in distribution network, this paper took typical shunt hybrid injection type active power filter (SHIAPF) as research subject, analyzed its corresponding compensation characteristics under four basic single index control strategies, and then, a new composite control strategy simultaneously contained load and grid harmonic currents was proposed to guarantee SHIAPF perform better in distribution network containing distributed generations. Before and after the penetration of distributed generation, the changes of SHIAPF compensation characteristics caused by harmonic-voltage injection, connection-impedance variation and frequency fluctuation were illustrated comparatively under the proposed composite control strategy or one single index control strategy. Simulation and experiment results have verified that the proposed composite control strategy could get better suppression effects against those fluctuations caused by distributed generation and ensure better compensation performances of SHIAPF, when distributed generation has a high penetration level in distribution network. It also can provide some practical references for further applications of SHIAPF and other power quality compensation equipments in distribution network containing distributed generations.

articleTitle: Analysis the electricity load and the summer air-conditioning load in Taizhou
abstract: The research level of electricity load analysis is an important measurement of management for electricity enterprise.During the past 10 years, China's power load analysis studies made great progress. Nevertheless, with the rapid development of China's electricity market, evolving and the emergence of power demand and electricity demand characteristics than electricity load analysis studies are far from adequate. We therefore urgently need to undertake a more in-depth maximum power load testing study more science, and the whole, effective strategies and methods of load analysis. This article is mainly based on the data from TaiZhou and other three regions SCADA system and weather information in TaiZhou 2006 July~August. We obtain the load curves of power and air-condition in the Spring and Summer.

articleTitle: Technical-economic analysis on application of Conductor Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer Cores on newly constructed line and reconstructed line
abstract: With the emergence of Conductor Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer Core, a new way to solve line capacity expansion, transmission corridor reduction and other problems is introduced. This paper analyzes the advantages and investigates the scientific research and application situation for this conductor. It can be seen from the result obtained from computational analysis of technical-economic efficiency of application of this conductor combining with typical parameters of 220kV reconstructed line and 500kV newly constructed line in China that the application of Conductor Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer Core is feasible from the perspective of technology and reasonable from the perspective of economy.

Author Keywords: Conductor Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer Core

articleTitle: The research and design of communication network construction for Nanjing distributing and consuming communication network
