abstract: Power distributing and consuming communication network is the key information infrastructure for the realization of the distribution grid automation, electric consumption information collection, bidirectional marketing interaction and smart grid, the important technical guarantee for the realization of the smart grid and the vital component for the communication networks in all regions. Integrating with the incoming development in Nanjing area of the power distribution automation pilot, electric consumption information collection pilot and community automation project and relying on the basis of index analysis for the business relating to the power distributing and consuming communication network including the business flow, business bandwidth, safety requirements, real-timing requirement and reliability requirement, this paper has made the bandwidth traffic prediction for all nodes and sections. Combining with the business demand and characteristics of all communication technologies, the main method of the EPON optical fibre of the dual bus network and the auxiliary method of the wireless public network are used for the design of the power distributing and consuming communication network.

Author Keywords: Power distributing and consuming communication network

articleTitle: ChRDB: A high performance RTDB system with object-oriented data representation architecture
abstract: To improve the flexibility and extensibility of traditional RTDB systems, which adopt field-specific ways of data representation that always leads to customized development whenever requirements changes, ChRDB manages all the data, both system dependent and project specific, in an object-oriented style. Customized types of data objects and corresponding instances can be easily created to satisfy any project-specific requirements newly devised. With the kernel module optimized in the platform-dependent level and wrapped into a uniform abstraction level, ChRDB can be ported to all the main-stream operation systems, including Windows and major UNIX variants. With the help of the performance adaptive mechanism that are driven by the supporting computing platform and the real-time responsiveness evaluation of client processes, ChRDB achieves high performance and availability as proved by both the simulation results and real-world operations.

articleTitle: Development and analyse of Electronic Transformers
abstract: Electronic Transformers (ECT, EVT)are a sort of sensors of reactive agents in the reactive layer of the Strategic Power Infrastructure Defense system, are sense organs of the SPID in the Smart Grid, are a sort of key devices for the Smart Grid. The past Electromagnetic Transformers can not satisfy desire. With rapid development of the fiber and sensor technique, the technology based on fiber isolation and transmission is more mellow and perfect. This paper expounds development and sorts of Electronic Transformers, analyses the characteristic and engineering application instance between two kinds of Electronic Transformers, points out the problem in Electronic Transformers production, bring forward the development direction and regarded problem of Electronic Transformers research.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of electrified railway on power grid
abstract: With the rapid development of electrified railway, its impact on power grid is becoming increasingly serious. This paper makes a summary of the operating principle and the characteristics of electrified railway, and comprehensively analyses the impact of electrified railway on power grid, with the analysis of the actual project. And then the measures to improve the impact of electrified railway on power grid have been put forward.

articleTitle: The new real-time control system of reactive power optimization
abstract: This paper uses non-linear programming optimal power flow algorithm with slack constraint to analyze reactive power real-time optimization problems in actual grid. And considering the effect of control action sequence on the optimal control effect, the control strategies of the reactive power real-time optimization control system are improved. The control action sequences in normal and failure circumstance are separately determined based on the control variables' active power loss control sensibility and voltage control sensibility, effectively avoiding the system oscillation caused by control variables changing at the same time. The application on IEEE-30 bus system verifies effectiveness and practicality of the algorithm and control strategy in this paper.

articleTitle: The application analysis of intelligent alarm expert system for Qingdao power grid
abstract: With the rapid development of Qingdao power grid, more and more alarm signals are processed on account of the huge amount of data for dispatching automation system which is an important part of Smart Grid, causing large workload and overlong inspecting time. Firstly the function and feature of the intelligent alarm expert system is introduced. Then the configuration and improvement combined with practice in Qingdao is discussed. Finally the application of the system is analyzed; showing that reasonable configuration of the expert system can improve efficiency of monitoring and the level of fault treatment in order to provide a secure guarantee for the operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Optimizition design of all-vanadium redox flow battery energy storage system
abstract: The redox active substance of all-vanadium redox flow battery (VRB) is stored in two separate tanks. In the pumped circulation, the solution flows through the battery, oxidation-reduction reaction takes place on the electrode in both sides of the ion exchange membrane. Compared with other kinds of secondary batteries, VRB has its own characteristics. The arrangement and design of VRB are very flexible, which largely benefit the association of different modules, and make the capacity of the battery may be large or small as the customer's wish. The battery system can respond at a high speed and output great power. The battery system is safe, stable and easy to maintain. Self-discharging is slight. Has a long life-cycle, high efficiency and cheap price, etc.. As a high-power power electronic equipment, the arrangement of PCS should pay special attention on the heat dissipation system. According to the actual power and structure of PCS, maybe take some electromagnetic shielding measure in the equipment room. Control and supervision system should be optimal designed, including BMS and other subsystems. Because there are not domestic regulations of arrangement and design about VRB ESS yet in China, in the future, should summarize experience in time from the actual projects, in order to promote the popularization and application of VRB technology in aspects as electric energy storage and user's spare power.

articleTitle: The selection strategy on the main parts of transformer and its performance parameters
abstract: The selection strategy on the main parts of transformer and its performance parameters are directly related to the transformer's reliable operation,security and economic. After investigations and analysis, some suggestions are made: the capacity and quantity of bushing current transformers should be selected reasonably; the present transformer's fire-protection devices should be removed, and most of the main transformer's tap-changer in power plant should be cancelled; in the premise of not increasing the costs of manufacturing, as the operation load rate of transformer, adjust the ratio between the no-load loss and load loss in order to get the transformer's operation economically and reasonably.

articleTitle: An enhanced water tree-retardant crosslinked polyethylene for improved reliability and longevity of distribution power cables
abstract: Additive “water tree-retardant” technology for crosslinked polyethylene insulation (TR-XLPE) has served the power distribution market well for over 25 years. The present work considers the opportunity to extend performance beyond TR-XLPE through the use of a supplemental additive to work in conjunction with the established tree-retardant additive technology. “Enhanced tree-retardant crosslinked polyethylene” (EnTR-XLPE) has demonstrated a significant extension in cable life in an accelerated wet-electrical cable test with 15 kV power cable cores subjected to an aging stress of 8kV/mm. The two-fold increase in cable life prompted evaluations of EnTR-XLPE in high-stress cable designs subjected to a 60% higher nominal aging stress (over 12 kV/mm). A qualitative comparison was conducted to determine the extent of water tree growth for cable samples of TR-XLPE and EnTR-XLPE aged under similar conditions. The results suggest that the EnTR-XLPE system reduced the density of small water-trees present and provided better resistance of vented water tree initiation from both the conductor shield and the insulation shield. Cables prepared with EnTR-XLPE also demonstrated stability of dissipation factor over several weeks of electrical aging with a 140°C conductor temperature, which is a requirement in the ICEA-ANSI standards for a continuous operating temperature rating of 105°C.

articleTitle: The research on economic loss of power quality disturbances by econometric model
abstract: It is known that electric power disturbances can cause abnormal equipment operation, resulting in the production line interruptions, equipment damage, product obsolescence, data loss and other serious incidents, significant losses. This paper studies on economic losses caused by voltage sag and short power outage within 3min. According to the voltage from the power grid and the sensitivity of user, constructing a calculation model of economic loss of voltage sag. By this model and related statistics of Xiamen 2008, calculate the economic loss of voltage sag. The model could be helpful for benefit- cost analysis of smart grid and decision making.

articleTitle: 3D real-time display system for cable temperature monitoring
abstract: 3D real-time display system of cable temperature monitoring is introduced in this paper. With the technology of distributed optical fiber measurement, real-time temperature getting from the full range monitoring of the power cable is used to build the 3D model of monitoring object, so that 3D real-time display could be realized for power cable temperature monitoring.

articleTitle: The application of distributed power supply system and CCHP in China's rural areas
abstract: At present, the development of rural power grid can't meet the requirements of rapid economic development. The traditional single power grid is difficult to meet the request, and distributed power generations have a lot of advantages compared to it, particularly it's close to the end users, and they have been developed well and applied widely in recent years. This paper presents a distributed energy supply system that can be generally applied in China's vast rural areas. Outlines the research background, development of distributed generations (DGs) and cogeneration of heat power and cool (CCHP). And then not only analyzes the application possibility of DGs and CCHP in rural areas. But also puts forward constructive views on how to get long-term development in China's rural areas.

articleTitle: Analysis of the 220kV line distance protection's measuring impedance when V/X traction transformer is in short circuit
abstract: Both of the traction transformers in the Shanghai-Nanjing intercity railway and Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway connect two single-phase traction transformers as V/X wiring to form a complete traction transformer. One is operating, and the other one stand-by for it. First, the thesis analyzes the low-voltage side short current of V/V wiring traction transformer, and then calculates the measuring impedance of the interphase and grounding impedance components of 220kV distance protection which is in power supply side substation. Furthermore, it analyzes the measuring impedance of the interphase and grounding impedance components in V/X wiring traction transformer when its low-voltage side is in short circuit. The conclusion has been tested to be correct by simulation experiments. All of the analyses and experiments indicate that 220kV line distance protection's minimum measuring impedance in power supply side substation is much smaller than the minimum measuring impedance of regular transformer in grid when the short circuit takes place in the low-voltage side of traction transformer. So it should be paid attention to set protection values to avoid setting mistakes. This conclusion is also suitable for the V/X wiring traction transformers which use 110kV and 220kV including the above voltage grade railway power supply network. In conclusion, the thesis puts forward some important opinions which should be paid attention to setting 220kV line distance protection. articleTitle: Energy meter monitoring sensor network technology research
abstract: Currently using high-tech means, in the meter to steal of rampant, illegal means and how many have concealed; and to prevent, detect, and investigate this unlawful manner is extremely difficult. Wuxi company last year through an anti-stealing power struggle, as at 20 September, the city in which a total of 127-stealing household electricity tariff measure correction house, 24.08, receive breaking electricity gold 86.02 million. Anti-stealing power struggle, is intensified Marketing Management Inc, safeguard the interests of the company a major step. But the present anti-stealing comparison of methods and means, and mainly rely on a single people, the stretch to troubleshoot, to implement, inefficient. And the use of “wireless sensor networks (of networking)”, and “software detection” technology, high-performance, wide coverage of the energy meter monitoring sensor network has the potential to wide scale opposite to the energy use of real time monitoring and effective regulation. Software detection sensor hardware is actually the main section is also a microprocessor (CPU) system, it includes: data acquisition, data processing and data transmission unit, in data transmission unit would include RF modules, software detection sensors that “runs”, and you can set the program flow at a specific elements for processing, converted to meet the needs of the output signal. Energy meter monitoring sensor network is to utilize software detection sensor meter run of the original code for real-time tracking and analysis, unusual, immediately track and wirelessly to meter in the use of cheats to information sent to the monitoring centre, which is anti-stealing proof provides a legal basis, so that the anti-stealing from the original artificial troubleshoot to high tech information-based smart power grid. Through the city or even country establish energy meter monitoring sensor networks, anti-stealing struggle to achieve a comprehensive victory.

articleTitle: Harmonic characteristic analysis of Capacitor Commutated Converter in HVDC system
abstract: Capacitor Commutated Converter (CCC) is a new kind of converter characterized by having capacitors inserted in between the converter transformer and the converter valves. Its behavior as harmonic source is the research point of this paper. Characteristic harmonics at the dc and ac side of CCC-HVDC system are studied, analyzed and compared with the Line Commutated Converter HVDC (LCC-HVDC) system. Thus it can analyze the influence of series capacitor at the dc and ac side characteristic harmonics of the converter. The research is based on the Qing-Zang HVDC transmission project (a planning project), and consists of two parts: theoretical calculations and simulation analysis. The simulation tool is PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: A load shedding method based on the power vacancy sensitivity analysis
abstract: The loss of a large capacity power plant or extra-high voltage transmission line in weak-connected power system may cause abundant power vacancy of consumer district. As a result, the system frequency will drop sharply. This paper presented a load-shedding method which is based on the power vacancy sensitivity analysis. Refer to the network structure after fault, it first calculates the sensitivity of power vacancy to load power and carries out the load-shedding according to the descending sequence of the sensitivity values, and then determines the load-shedding amount by the time-domain simulation method. As the precaution before the traditional UFLS (Under Frequency Load Shedding) method, this method could effectively raise the system frequency with minimal load-shedding. EPRI-36 system is used to demonstrate the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: New 20kV network concept for an existing distribution network
abstract: This paper presents a study of a distribution network of the large city in a former republic of the Soviet Union. The current situation is analyzed and a new network concept is developed. The major part of the current electrical network has been built in the 1960th and 70th using old Russian technology. The economy develops strongly in the last years, and it can be estimated that the total consumption will roughly double within the next 15 years. Today the distribution network is using several voltage levels. A lot of the electrical equipment in the network is reaching the end of its lifetime in the coming years. Therefore and due to the historical developments in the network structure, reliability is low compared to European standards. For these reasons a new network concept has been developed in a consulting project undertaken by Siemens PTI and described in this paper. Especially for the new and optimal network concept for the city, the reduction of the large number of existing voltage levels has been proposed by introducing a new 20 kV level. The Greenfield planning approach is used for this task to achieve the optimal solution for the network. Finally a way is presented to transform the current network step-by-step into the recommended 20 kV solution with future oriented and optimized network structure for the year 2025. The objective of these steps is to achieve a fast improvement of network reliability.

articleTitle: Measurement based on the “group linear regression method” of harmonic impedance
abstract: Harmonic pollution monitoring and control is the key to an accurate estimate of harmonic impedance, and thus an accurate assessment of public connection points of the harmonic emission level. This paper analyzes the link under the star-shaped and triangular three-phase asymmetrical power systems derived established a three-phase unbalanced power system harmonic impedance matrix estimation model. Model is based on a large number of systems and load the public connection point of the simulation data, the real and imaginary part of the harmonic impedance by opening and using grouping multiple linear regression method, on the system side harmonic impedance matrix to estimate the value of each element. Simulation and error analysis shows that the model obtained is more accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Impacts of grid-connected photovoltaic generation on distribution networks
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the impacts of the grid-connected PV generation systems regarding the intermittent nature of renewable generation, and the characterization of PV generation with regard to grid code compliance. The impacts described here include effects that have traditionally been considered a potential concern by the electricity industry, covering voltage, current and power effects arising from the individual or multiple operations of PV grid-connected systems. Also, added value capabilities of PV systems are presented, which can provide additional benefits to distribution networks.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant control system research based on dual CPU redundancy for high-voltage inverter
abstract: With the deepening of China's reform and the rapid development of economic construction, the needs of energy-saving and environmental protection are growing significantly. As the optimal method of induction motor control, high-voltage frequency conversion technology has been widely used. In some industries the reliability of high-voltage high frequency device is concerned. The purpose of this paper is to provide the method of multi-CPU redundancy, fault-tolerant design based on high-voltage inverter, to enhance the reliability of the high voltage inverter. With the application, high-voltage inverter control system can automatically switch main and standby CPU without stopping motor or affecting the operation. The situation that frequency can not be adjusted or motor must be stopped for errors can be avoided. This improves the continuous operation and reliability of control system and the whole system.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of HVDC primary frequency regulation
abstract: Primary frequency regulation is the important means to maintain the frequency stability of power systems. Such as large power network, in case of insufficient reserve capacity of frequency regulation, steady state value of frequency deviation can not satisfy the frequency quality. What's more, sometimes delay of turbo-generator is bigger,the speed of load changing can not be satisfied by primary frequency regulation. So that bigger frequency deviation is produced. In this paper, a case of two areas via a parallel AC-DC links is discussed. Dynamic characteristics are studied on auxiliary primary frequency regulation (APFR) of HVDC. The results show that the speed of primary frequency regulation is increased and dynamic frequency deviation is decreased by APFR.

articleTitle: Application of JAVA technique on the Report Form Management System of distribution management systems in Power Network
abstract: Report Form Management System (RFMS) is an important part of distribution management systems in Power Network, and it gives accurate and real-time power-grid information to distribution dispatching personals in the form of electronic tables. To counter the disadvantages of traditional Report Form System, this paper puts forward a new RFMS to use JAVA, a high-level multi-platform programming language, to develop a Report Form Management System with more customized style.

articleTitle: Protection computers or protection relays?
abstract: The recently introduced communications standard IEC61850 is having a major impact on the structure of new protection systems and schemes. In itself it describes the concepts for sub-station communications covering protection, control and metering functions. However, although it is going to have a major impact on the power systems communications, it will also influence the design of future protection systems. How are protection systems going to develop in light of IEC61850? Will these be protection computers or protection relays? The aim of IEC61850 is to reduce costs, respond to the increasing demands for communications and to provide for standard protocols available from different manufacturers. It aims to provide for future-proofed equipment, interoperability of equipment from different manufacturers and easing the management of future power system sub-station equipment. There will also be a host of other opportunities and advantages that can be realised. These include easier repair, refurbishment and replacement of protection. They also provide for greater use of general purpose IEDs, self healing systems, and plug and play type facilities. The paper examines how future generations of protection systems will develop in order to meet these objectives. It takes a close look at the development of distributed computer systems and draws several parallels from this pointing to the possible future computerised protection. The future for protection systems is full of change, challenge and promise. The rate of change will be governed by the acceptance of the new concepts by the industry. Change is inevitable and the driving forces are well established.

articleTitle: A method of collaborative multi-path load forecasting based on maximum entropy principle
abstract: This paper introduces synergetic theory and proposes multi-path load forecasting automatically coordinated approach based on the maximum entropy principle. Taking the expectation and second order central moment of forecasted results into account and using the maximum entropy principle,this synergetic load forecasting method receives the probability distribution function of the forecasted values and obtains the final high, middle and low forecasting scheme based on the probability theory. Case study has shown the model and method mentioned above can take the affection of the conflicts among different forecasting path into account in forecasting, resulting in higher precision of load forecasting.

articleTitle: Decision-making analysis of 10kV to 20kV distribution network transformation
abstract: With the characteristics of the long duration and many influencing factors, this paper proposed a new decision-making analysis method by using the dynamic multi-objective decision-making analysis model. The optimal scheme, that can be met both economic and technical demands of the 10kV to 20kV step-up transformation projects, was obtained. In the final application example, the method this paper proposed proved its practical significance to some extent.

articleTitle: Application and development research of 220kV transformer protection with special configuration based on impedance algorithm
abstract: This paper describes that the use of large capacity110kV transformers in Jiangsu power grid makes the mismatch between the capacity of 220kV transformer and the capacity of 110kV transformer. As the capacity of 110kV transformer is too large, its short-circuit impedance is relative small, while the capacity of 220kV transformer capacity is relative small, the conventional configuration and setting of transformer protection may results in the conflict between the protection of the 110kV line, the back-up protection of 220kV transformer and 110kV transformer protection, Which may lead to leapfrog trip of the back-up protection of 110kV side of 220kV transformer, and the wide-area blackout. This paper sets out the strategy and feasibility way to solve the problem, such as the using of the large-capacity 220kV transformer, but it is unrealistic. This paper puts forward a simple and effective way that the impedance protection is used as the corresponding back-up protection of 220kV transformer. Cooperating with two companies, the protection device based on impedance protection has been developed. The result of static test and dynamic test showed that the configuration is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Research about alarm system for grounding cable disconnection in high-voltage cable grounding system
abstract: The theft of Grounding and coaxial cables, leads to the breakdown of cable protection layer's weak insulation and cable burning that may develop into a big accident indirectly without timely discovery and grounding system repair. The paper introduces a new alarm system for grounding cable disconnection. Its function, structure and characteristics are discussed and the paper emphatically expounds the key technology and the project optimization about disconnection signal acquisition module, suspension CT power supply module, power management module, signal monitoring management module, GSM module, remote monitoring software module etc., and also discusses the feasibility of the application of on-line monitoring.

articleTitle: Applications of intelligent tuning technology in passive power filters
abstract: Through the analysis of the problems existed in the passive harmonic filters, this paper proposed a real time intelligent tuning technology and its application in passive harmonic filters. The control algorithm, parameter setting and protection coordination are presented in an application case.

articleTitle: Research on complex multi-state distribution system reliability modeling and assessment methods based on Bayesian networks and random set theory
abstract: For the difficulties of quantitative analysis in the reliability of power distribution system composed of the multi-state components and the limitations of the traditional fault-tree reliability evaluation in the distribution system,a new method of modeling and assessment of multi-state distribution system reliability based on BN and random set theory are proposed in this paper. By using the advantages of the establishment of a clear hierarchy of power distribution system model composed of the uncertain sources and figurative direct expression of Bayesian network, This model not only plays a role in distribution system reliability evaluation indicators, but also quantitatively analyses the impact of the components on the system which is on the basis of unified random set model of classical combination rules included DemPster combination rule?The model is presented in this paper provide a solid foundation for improved in distribution system. This paper uses Bayesian network to analyze a 10KV substation which contains 8 outlet, 12 circuit breaker, isolating switch 38, 106 Fuse on TAIZHOU city, Zhejiang Province. Algorithm calculate the distribution system reliability targets, but also can calculate the probability of the various components under the conditions of the probability of the system to normal or fault operational status. Improve distribution system reliability purposes can be achieved by locate to improve the reliability of certain components Therefore, the proposed algorithm can calculate the reliability index at the same time calculate the various components probability on the conditions of the system state, both draw on the overall assessment of the entire distribution system, but also play a role in diagnosis of weak links. Have been tested to verify the legitimacy and effectiveness of the algorithm, this method can be applied to a complex distribution system reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Enhancing the contribution from distributed generation using Smart grids
abstract: Distributed generation offers the potential to deliver power close to the point of use and to maintain consumer's supplies during network disturbances which result in the loss of the grid connection. As always these opportunities create a series of challenges, for which Smart grids, their component systems and innovation offer solutions. The first challenge highlighted in this paper is to maintain or maximise the active power output of the distributed generation while observing the network's voltage constraints during normal operation. The second challenge is managing the transition from grid connected to islanded operation following a network disturbance. Although this is not permitted under current UK regulations, there are no fundamental reasons which can not be overcome. Finally, there is the challenge of rebuilding the network and restoring the grid connection, facilitating 'normal' operation following a disturbance. Identifying and understanding the challenges, together with a proper appreciation of the facilities offered by smart grids leads to new techniques which can aid the full exploitation distributed generation.

articleTitle: China MV distribution network benchmark for network integrated of renewable and distributed energy resources
abstract: A China MV distribution network benchmark and a common testing basis for the integration of renewable and distributed energy resources (DER) were proposed in this paper. Typical China MV distribution network structure and load information of nodes were also proposed in the benchmark, which can be applied in testing the standardization and integration of renewable and DER. The validity of the benchmark and testing basis was evaluated by a model system integrated with renewable and DER. The results demonstrate the practicability and effectiveness that the benchmark to analyze and verify the integration of renewable and DER.

articleTitle: Application of IEC 61850 proxy in seamless communication between digital substation and control centre
abstract: The paper deals with application requirements of seamless communication between digital substation and control centre, especially model harmonization between IEC 61850 and 61970. The necessity and feasibility of IEC 61850 proxy acting as a communication server in substation is introduced. It also describes the proxy software design of functions and architecture. The proxy makes full consideration of IEC 61850 and 61970 application technologies, such as modeling methods, configuration tool, real-time database, IEC 61850 ACSI client, services mapping, access security, maintenance and hardware. The proxy features prefect functions, simple configuration and easy maintenance, and will become an important front-end communication device in future construction of smart substation, providing technological support for seamless connections between heterogeneous systems in smart grid.

articleTitle: Abnormal voltage flicker analyze at the point of common coupling
abstract: The purpose of power quality monitoring is to realizing analyze evaluation and comprehensive treatment. If power quality monitoring data couldn't reflect exactly power quality of real grids, then the following data analyze and research based on the monitoring data is meaningless. This paper analyzed the and actually monitoring data approved the significance of flagging the voltage transient events. The result has an important significance about power quality monitoring and data processing.

articleTitle: Modeling of ac arc furnace and its influence on the relay protection
abstract: This paper presents a novel model of the electric arc furnace (EAF) based on energy conservation theory. Starting from the arc energy balancing equation for the electric arc, the proposed model is able to reflect the steady-state operating characteristic of arc furnace accurately. Then the dynamic arc furnace model can be obtained by modulating the definitive model with white noises. The model is proved to be accurate and valid tested by simulation. Due to the adverse effects produced by the operation of arc furnace, it also analyzes the influence on the protective relay, which includes: the mal-operation of negative sequence relay and frequent operation of startup component. The suppressing measures with reasonable results for these problems are also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: The research of the information interaction technology about intelligent electricity utilization between the power supply company and the big customers
abstract: Through the research and the application of the information interactive technology between the power supply company and the big customers, it is possible to realize the power utilization automation of the customers, thus the power supply company can apply the failure positioning, the power utility management and the monitoring to the power supply terminal, and therefore, meet the various requirements of the customers and increase the quality of services. At the same time, this technology helps the customers change the traditional power utilization mode and habits, to increase the efficiency of the equipment and save the energy costs of the big customers.

articleTitle: Distributed generation and Demand Side Management
abstract: Distributed generation technologies have emerged against bad environment and energy crisis, and they have been developed well in recent years. Lots of people have paid more and more attention to smart grid at home and abroad. This article analyzes the important role of the distributed power generation in the modern network's security and reliability, particularly the application and development of distributed generation (DG) in the smart grid. Demand Side Management (DSM) must balance the contradictions between the supply system and consumption, as an emerging power generation industry, the main feature is that they are close to the users and can operate independently or grid-connected. In addition to emphasizing the importance of DGs in DSM, paper demonstrates the importance and necessity of DGs and DSM's coordinated operation in the smart grid.

articleTitle: A spectral correction approach for harmonic/inter-harmonic analysis based on the odd points' interpolation
abstract: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) is one of the most commonly used techniques for harmonic and inter-harmonic analysis in electric power system. However, the asynchronous sampling will cause spectral leakage and fence effect on each component of the signal in the frequency domain. Traditional interpolation approaches commonly use specific window with better spectrum characteristics to restrain the leakage interferences among all the components and use spectral lines' interpolation to conquer the fence effect. Different from the traditional approaches, a new spectral correction approach for harmonic and inter-harmonic analysis is presented in this paper. It solves the two drawbacks of the DFT by simply odd points' interpolation without applying any windows, and can locate all the components accurately. The simulation results indicate that the proposed approach is not only adapted for leakage elimination, but also adapted for the extraction of weak components.

articleTitle: The application of temporary earth voltage (TEV) measurement in the online monitoring of the partial discharge of HV switch cabinet
abstract: With the wide spread of HV switch cabinet in the electric system, how to effectively monitor the insulation inside the cabinet to avoid the fault is an important subject which all technicians are confronted with. The principle of the TEV measurement and its application in electric system are introduced to demonstrate the effectiveness of this method in the online test of partial discharge in the HV switch cabinet with the real case.

articleTitle: Analysis on burning failures with 110kV dry-type reactors by salinity accumulation
abstract: Two times of burning failures with 110kV ACF dry-type reactors happened in ±500kV Gaoling Converter Substation because of the salinity and dirtiness accumulation. The first time happened with No.5642 ACF group at Northeast Grid side and kept burning for 2h when the dry-type reactor was totally damaged. 12 days later No.5632 ACF group at North Grid side burned and resulted in all the noise-absorbing sponge on the sound-proof cover ruined. After an investigation, the sponge accumulated the salinity airing from the near sea and got a reduction of insulation capability accompanying with humidity. The sponge burned by discharge with high voltage. After the sponge was totally removed the reactors have been working safely for one year.

articleTitle: The research on 220 kV Tower Design of narrow-based
abstract: I had the honor full participation in the research on the 220 kV tower of narrow-based and experimental work. As the first in Jiangsu Province, narrow base tower of 220 kV line is smoothly put into use. Narrow base tower technology will be gradually extended, and has good prospects for development. This article focuses on the overhead line tower at home and abroad the status quo of the narrow base tower application, summed up the narrow base of 220 KV tower of the specific features of the process and put forward such a tower construction, acceptance criteria for the discussion.

articleTitle: Service-oriented provincial-centralized transmission and distribution GIS platform
abstract: This paper introduces the major focus for the service-oriented provincial-centralized transmission-distribution-integrated GIS platform, its architecture, application deployment and key technology. Based on versioned power system model and graphics repository on Oracle, independent from third-party GIS software, the system provides spatial information application server of real-time performance, network builder and WebGIS control component. For optimal performance, the database storage has been optimized and smart incremental client cache has been implemented.

articleTitle: Research on the high reliable integrated power utilization information real-time collection system
abstract: The author has worked out a solution to the electricity data collection problem which integrated the various communication methods, and developed the products such as electricity data collection system master station, multi-functional concentrator, multi functional collectors and repeaters. After deep analysis on the different communication methods, the author has proposed three methods for the remote communication via EPON communication, public wireless network communication and ZigBee communication, five methods for the local communication via low-voltage broadband carrier wave communication, low voltage narrowband carrier wave communication, ZigBee communication, Ethernet communication, CAN communication. Furthermore, in order to increase the reliability and real-time communication, the author has proposed a double-path collection system. The integrated electricity data collection system as proposed in this thesis fits the needs from all geographic and equipment environment of different users, this is really a practical solution for the electricity data collection problem and is very valuable to be introduced to the industry.

articleTitle: Not neutral earthing eystem voltage imbalance analysis and treatment
abstract: Not neutral earthing system voltage imbalance in the actual operation of the power system which often occurred through the anomaly occurred when the voltage of the analysis to find out the reasons for the imbalance occurred, and then depending on the specific reasons for treatment. So this phenomenon in the study of very important practical significance. Based on the six-voltage power system imbalances in the analysis, through their respective voltage imbalance and a symbol of the analysis, summed up the difference between judgement methods, and to make practical operation in which the handling of such cases, the entire Transforming power system operating voltage imbalance in the handling of professional basis.

articleTitle: The development of monitoring and analyzing system of voltage sag
abstract: It is necessary to monitor and analyze the power quality firstly in order to solve the power quality problems in power system, and then the possible reforming project can be put forward for improving power supply quality. According to the actual situation in the region, a system approach to voltage sag monitoring and analyzing has been designed and developed. The system and its composition, software design, network architecture and application effects, etc, are detail introduced, analyzed and discussed in this paper. System software, including front-desk program, the background-desk program, analysis software, adopt homemade advanced unary multi-point voltage sag criterion used for giving more voltage sag characteristics, improves the monitoring accuracy¿second-order Butterworth low-pass filters designed to reduce the impact of the voltage harmonics on the voltage sag detection algorithm, so reduces misjudgment rate during the voltage sag detection. The system has taken a series of measures, including signal acquisition, signal isolation module, anti-jamming, that is why it has a good reliability and stability. In the May 1 2007, a load rejection and voltage sag incident occurred in a 110kV substation, the device accurate records provided significant assistance to the accident analysis. The system meets the design requirements, that is, can be online accurately, high-density monitors the measurement system's three-phase bus voltage. Measurement system can accurately record the system operation state, the voltage sag occurs in the system will be accurate and timely recorded, and be able to regularly analyze the overall operation of the system voltage, it is beneficial to make detailed, scientific judgments and analysis for the system voltage sag and incidents.

articleTitle: Application of small capacity single-pole-mounted transformers to the complicated environmental districts in Shanghai central urban area
abstract: The bulky traditional transformers are inconvenient to be transported and installed for the high habitation density and the narrow congest environment in the shanties and old lanes in Shanghai central urban districts, which results in an awful power supply and low voltage problems in these districts. In this paper, a new method is proposed that using S11 series small capacity single-pole-mounted transformers and 10 kV insulated interwoven down-lead to supply power for the complicated environmental districts in Shanghai central urban area, which has great effect to improve the energy quality in these districts. The distribution network of a typical district in Shanghai is analyzed as an example, in which the above-mentioned method is used for improving the power supply quality in this district. This practical example validates that the proposed method has a good application effect and is valuable for further application.

articleTitle: Cause analysis on the break of isolator helical spring
abstract: Carries on the fracture macroscopic analysis, the SEM analysis, degree of hardness inspection, the chemical element analysis and the organization analysis to the break isolator helical spring, thought the isolator spring because of the surface decarburization level existence, receives the outer layer fixed friction to cause the micro crack the germination, the expansion is the spring break primary cause‥

articleTitle: Construction risks based energy-saving reconstruction of distribution transformers
abstract: For solving diseconomy problems in distribution transformers reconstruction, simple and practical criterions based on the actual situation are developed to judge the various parameters of distribution transformers. The distribution transformers selected without construction risks are divided into three parts and they considered to be reconstructed for energy saving, such as replacing for new energy-saving distribution transformers, and increasing the capacity for high-load rate transformers. For each part of the distribution transformers, the reconstruction scheme under constraints with the least ratio of investment and efficiency is optimal. The overall optimal scheme is composed of each optimal scheme. A certain line in Chongqing area is taken as example. Distribution transformer reconstruction schemes are developed using the method. The computed result shows that the method can reduce line losses effectively, while increasing operation level of equipment.

articleTitle: Study of increasing the usage of Decentral Co-generation System by use of Cooling or Heat Water Storage
abstract: Against the question of low usage of practical Decentral Co-generation System, the prime constrained reason is got after investigation and study. The technique of Cooling or Heat Water Storage is given a brief introduction as its technical and economic superiority, then it is made that the starting program of reforming existing Decentral Co-generation System by utilizing cooling or heat water storage, and forcast its reform effect. The drawn conclusion can provide it with reference that engineering design and application of Decentral Co-generation System.

articleTitle: A power quality aided service system based on electricity information network
abstract: This paper presents a power quality aided service system based on power supply enterprise's electricity information network, a integrated management platform which can manage power quality monitoring data; evaluate the effect of disturbance loads and design and check the parameters of filter and SVC systems is implemented. In the system, each sub function Web service is encapsulated as an agent abstractly; each user's function view and each aided service function can be combined dynamically by agents; the system use the contract net protocol based on Web service as the multi-agent cooperation way. These measures optimize the aided service performance and enhance the intelligence, sharing and expansibility of the platform. By accessing to the electricity information network Management departments at all levels inside power supply enterprise can use the system to accomplish the sharing of information and technical supervision interaction. It also realizes the standardization and normalization of power quality technical supervision.

articleTitle: Application significance of Electronic Transformers for Smart Grid
abstract: The Smart Grid are the development direction of the power grid in each nation. Electronic Transformers are sense organs of the Self-Healing Grid. The paper has discussed the development course of the Self-Healing Grid, requirements for Electronic transformers by the Smart Grid and International standards, the application of Electronic Transformers in the Smart Grid.

articleTitle: Energy conservation diagnosis of power enterprises in China based on circular economy -inspiration to China from the Japanese enterprises diagnosis system
abstract: Based on the “5R” principle of circular economy, this article introduced the government-led energy conservation diagnosis system, the basic constitution of energy conservation diagnosis and the specific process of diagnosis of Japanese enterprises. The energy management assurance system and specific operation procedure of energy conservation process were constructed, then its' guidance and reference significance for energy conservation of Chinese enterprises was analyzed. Combined with Chinese reality, this study suggests that the important premise and guarantee of completing the energy conservation and emission reduction targets are to improve the internal organization and management of institutions of enterprises.

articleTitle: Application and research of RDID technology in power energy measurement
abstract: In order to avoid occurring the things of forging or changing the measurement verification seal and stealing station resources, study and design the forgery-proof electronic seal of RFID. It improves the defensive level than the traditional defensive and prevents forging and changing the seal of measurement. When using with card reader on palm(palm machine), it is very convenient for checking up on the spot. By using it, the seal management in the measurement verification center of electric power can achieve the microcomputer automation management.

articleTitle: Engineering application of Construction Technology for re-using the original foundation
abstract: The exchange of 2502 circuit breaker, 220 kV side, II main transformer, Wuxi JiangXi electric substation(CIRCUIT BREAKER2502), works as an engineering example, through concrete projects and plans for presentation and analysis, demonstrating the construction technology feasibility of implanting chemical anchor bolts into the original foundation. Practical application in engineering and the test results of construction verify the reliability of the construction technology; by comparison with the traditional construction process, it also demonstrates the technology has clear advantages for economic indicators.

articleTitle: Discussion on Digital Distribution Automation System based on IEC 61850
abstract: A concept of Digital Distribution Automation System (DAS) is present in this paper, and design of digital distribution automation and the construction model are analyzed. Applications of ECT/EVT, IEC 61850, local digital technology and fiber Ethernet communication in digital distribution automation are discussed; a program for practical Digital DAS is put forward to present ideas for future development.

articleTitle: Application of pole-mounted transformer monitoring system in reducing the electric loss in LV distribution network
abstract: A new pole-mounted transformer monitoring system based on the remote communication technologies is introduced in this paper, and the system's main structure, function and primary technical parameters are given. The authors analyze and conclude the applications of the monitoring system in line loss reduction of 10kV transmission lines, 220/380V distribution network and 10kV pole-mounted transformers in detail. The practical examples validate the utility and feasibility of the monitoring system in decreasing the energy loss in LV distribution network, which provides the statistical basis for the precision management of line loss, reconstruction of LV distribution network and rational deployment of pole-mounted transformers.

articleTitle: Chaotic artificial neural network in reactive power optimization of distribution network
abstract: This thesis mainly focused on the study of reactive power optimization of distribution network by using Chaotic Artificial Neural Network. It established the optimization model of power distribution from the comparison with high voltage power system, and implemented it by Chaotic Artificial Neural Network. It depend on Chaotic Artificial Neural Network imitating the pain point of the grid, that once there was unsuitable reactive power on the line, the nerve cell could fell pain and had a pain output. Then we could find out where there was unsuitable reactive power, and redistribute reactive power once more, till the optimization of reactive power result had been found out. To overcome the poorly computational efficiency of simple Artificial Neural Network, we combined with Perceptron Network, Self-organizing ANN and Hopfield ANN to rebuild a new Chaotic Artificial Neural Network. So we also made an improvement of it to enhance its searching efficiency. At last, the calculation results showed that the presented method was effective through a calculation of a real distribution network with 30 nodes in IEEE. This method was also suitable for Smart Grid.

articleTitle: Ferro-resonance over-voltage and power frequency over-voltage on the neutrals of 220kV power transformer and corresponding protection strategy
abstract: In order to limit short-circuit current and satisfy the need of relay setting, only part of the 220kV power transformer is grounded, so on the neutrals of ungrounded transformers will appear the over-voltage. Currently the value of over-voltage on transformer neutral point and the corresponding protection strategy is based on theoretical formula, this article use the PSCAD/EMTDC software to calculate the over-voltage on the neutral point of 4 ungrounded power transformers in Chongqing 220kV power grid, the result shows that the power frequency transient over-voltage on the neutrals may reach 178kV, If the single-phase grounding fault occurs in ungrounded power system, the power frequency over-voltage on the neutrals will be more serious and rise to 138.6kV. Non-full phase operation may cause serious ferro-resonance over-voltage on the neutrals of no-load transformer, which may last for seconds and may rise to 723.7kV, causing serious threat to the transformer neutrals and line-side equipment. The article also studies the gap parameter which should be taken on the neutrals of 220kV transformers at the end.

articleTitle: Economic loss assessment of voltage sags
abstract: As one of the major problems of modern power quality, voltage sag will bring huge economic losses. From the economic point of view, assessment of voltage sags is discussed in the paper, on the basis of analyzing the main factors of voltage sag causing economic losses. According to the composition ratio and changes in voltage tolerance range of sensitive equipments, voltage tolerance curve (VTC) of integrated load-sensitive can be obtained. On this basis, the equipment failure probability matrix (P), voltage sag frequency matrix (F) and economic loss matrix (E) are defined, with the remaining voltage and the sag duration as variables. In addition, the quality loss function is introduced to evaluate the economic losses of various types of voltage sags, thereby establishing the economic loss assessment method of voltage sags. By knowing from the analysis, the method is convenient, fast and accurate, which can assess the economic losses of voltage sag effectively.

articleTitle: Overcurrent fault fast isolation technology in distribution line based on network
abstract: A new overcurrent fault isolation technology in distribution line based on network is presented. The FTU detects fault and exchanges fault data with the adjacent FTUs by peer-to-peer communication technology. The FTUs at both ends of the faulted section will trip the circuit breakers to isolate the fault. Then FTU at the tie breaker will close the tie breaker to restore supply.

articleTitle: Relay protection setting calculation system in distribution networks
abstract: With continuous development of distribution power network, the higher reliability of distribution system is required. Fault and its impact must be reduced to ensure reliable power supply in the operation of distribution network, so the relay protection is paid more and more attention. The existing relay allocation and settings systems are mostly suitable for high voltage power network and can't adapt to distribution network very well, because the distribution network is quite different from high-voltage network in topology, component properties and operation mode.

articleTitle: Reason analysis on the accident of high voltage XLPE cable
abstract: An accident of fire breakdown on high voltage XLPE cable is introduced in this paper in detail. As per the accident investigation analysis we found that there were various problems deal with cable manufacture, installation work, approval work and operation work etc., and finally caused the cable fault occurrence. Based on the accident analysis, some suggestions are proposed to prevented the similar accident occurs again.

articleTitle: Status and improvement of China's renewable energy legislation
abstract: The Law on Renewable Energy in China has played an important role in promoting the development of renewable energy industry since it was enforced in 2006. However, many problems are exposed in the process of its implementation. How to tackle the legislative conflicts and lag on renewable energy law affects the sustainable and healthy development of renewable energy industry and the construction of environmental legal system. This paper reviews the evolution of renewable energy legislation, combing the form and content of existing renewable energy legislation, analyzing the major problems of current system and their causes, and then put forward several countermeasures and suggestions for improving China's renewable energy legislation.

articleTitle: Research on emulation operating characteristics of GuiLin isolated power system based on RTDS
abstract: Frequency stability is the critical problem for isolated power grid. According to the actual situation of GuiLin isolated operation mode, a detailed single machine alone net simulation model was found which based on the YongFu power plant, though a lot of simulation test and theoretical analysis, the effect on the isolated power grid frequency stability that caused by parameter setting of the governor system, excitation control system and the load characteristic is deeply analyzed, the research result has important significance in guiding operating of actual isolated power grid.

articleTitle: Characteristics of air conditioners load and its impact on regional grid analysis
abstract: Air conditioners deserve special attention because they represent a significant part of the power system load. The modeling of air conditioners load is analyzed for simulation purposes, a simple methodology for modeling the effects of air conditioners load for short-term voltage stability analysis is presented and evaluated using a regional grid. Furthermore, the influence of the recover air conditioners load on the power system is analyzed. The result shows that the higher air conditioner ratio is, the heavier negative influence is on the network.

articleTitle: Experimental research on 10kV fast busbar protection system with GOOSE technology
abstract: GOOSE mechanism provides new method for equipping 10kV fast busbar protection with its rapidity, feasibility and flexibility. This paper introduces the scheme of 10kV fast busbar protection and the differences between method of traditionality and method with GOOSE technology. Based on an experiment operated, some complete analysis conclusions are made, and which show the fast busbar protection technology not only satisifies the Real-time request of protection process, but also basically meets the need of protection logic system.

articleTitle: Voltage control scheme of Nanjing distribution grid based on 10kV voltage regulator
abstract: A large number of distribution generators are interconnected into Nanjing distribution network in Fujian Power grid. The amplitude of voltage in this grid changes largely and frequently. In this paper, the voltage problem in Nanjing power grid is analyzed in BPA. And the feasibility of 10kV voltage regulator application in voltage control is verified. And set compared group, compare the difference effects between series capacitors, shunt reactors and the voltage regulator in solving the same voltage problem in Nanjing grid. And then the voltage control scheme by voltage regulator is given. In the final part, the collocating position and the capacity are given through simulation. The results calculated by simulation shows that the voltage regulator is effective voltage control means in power grid with distribution generators.

articleTitle: Identification of bad data of power system based improved GSA judgment
abstract: The power system security and stability of operation are determined by the accuracy of real-time data. A improvement judgment is made based on bad data detection using GSA (Gap Statistic Algorithm) data mining method, and is applied on bad data detection in power system. The Improvement judgment: elbow judgment was presented, which analyzes the relation between the error measures and the number of clusters k of the data set, then calculates the elbow angle at k and obtain the optimal number of clusters based on the least elbow angle. Combined the criterion with GSA, bad data detection could be implemented efficiently. Through simulation with real-time data from a power company, results show the detective method is accurate and rapid, and has the very good application prospects.

articleTitle: Research and implementation on power system stabilizer PSS4B model
abstract: This paper introduced the power system stabilizer PSS4B model in detail with its advantages, parameter setting and the implementation method on excitation regulator. It would promote the power system stabilizer technology, and provide a better technical support for the construction of strong and smart grid in our country.

articleTitle: Research of APF based on fuzzy-sliding mode variable structure control strategy
abstract: The nonlinear load, impact and power imbalances as a result of serious pollution of the characteristics with the grid. The traditional method of active filter control systems rely on accurate mathematical model and has poor robustness, It is difficult to obtain good control performance. A shunt three-phase active power filter based on fuzzy-sliding mode variable structure control. It is modulated converter to make the active filter has a more favorable effect of the dynamic compensation. A three-phase three-wire active filter system simulation model based on the above control strategies and modulation scheme is established in matlab. The results of simulation show the control method is feasible; it has good dynamic and static performance in this system.

articleTitle: Research and application of a reliability growth model for 220 kV power transmission and distribution installations
abstract: A reliability growth model for 220 kV power transmission and distribution installations is presented. Ways for estimating and fitting on checking the model's parameters are given together analysis results concerning the reliability growth of six kinds of 220 kV power transmission and distribution installations, such as 220 kV power transformers, circuit breakers, isolating switches, surge arresters, current transformers and voltage transformers. On site operation, statistical reliability data show that the reliability growth model conforms to rules of reliability growth tendency. Analysis results of reliability growth indicate that measures taken for improving maintenance and operation by the power companies are effective and the reliability of the domestic power transmission and distribution installations exhibit a rising tendency. Applications of the reliability growth model to predict the change tendency of reliability for transmission and distribution installations is suitable.

articleTitle: Research on control method of two single-phase B2B STATCOM in traction system
abstract: A novel power conditioner based on two single-phase B2B STATCOM, which is used for active power accommodation in electric railway, is proposed in this paper. It could achieve bi-directional energy transmission between two feed lines so as to balance the load of the two lines, which could not only decrease the negative sequence current significantly, but also improve the capability of railway transportation. Meanwhile, the two converters could also compensate reactive power of their own feed lines independently. A hierarchical control structure is adopted in the novel power conditioner, which contains system-level and converter-level control. Power transfer between two feed lines is given by mathematical derivation firstly, and simulation is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the equipment and the control algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the line redundancy protection of GOOSE digital network substation
abstract: In a traditional substation, when a failure in microprocessor-based line protection device in a hardware is detected, such as RAM error, EPRAM error and set the value of an error, the power failure protection devices such circumstances would be out of operation. With the device out of operation, the related line protection devices have to quit running, thereby reducing the reliability and continuity of the power supply. In the Hanzhong Xinyuan Digital Substation GOOSE network through the use of a 110kV line protection to achieve redundancy, that is, two line protection using only a single protection of the realization of two pairs of double-line protection configuration, Any one out of Line Protection Device for some reason, run-time redundancy protection fault protection device can immediately put into operation an alternative. To ensure the normal operation of the power supply line, the method is currently the country first.

articleTitle: Research for calibration technology of digital input electric energy meter
abstract: As China is developing smart grid with great strength, more and more digital substations will be built, therefore, it is time for thinking of the accuracy of metering devices. But the digital input electric energy meter is different on signal transmission with traditional meter, requiring a new calibration method. By sampling analog power standard output, we bring in a special power standard according to IEC61850. Based on the special power standard, this article introduces a new calibration technology, including equipment design, error correction and value-traceability.

articleTitle: Impact of vacuum switch-disconnectors on reliability of MV distribution networks
abstract: Using vacuum technology in 100% of distribution switchgears will increase the number of vacuum interrupters in the network by a factor of 20. Here a statistical analysis is used to evaluate the consequences of a complete substitution of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) by vacuum insultaed Switchgears on the reliability of a cable network. Frequency of insulation failures is similar to this due to the vacuum switchgear already used in main distribution. The Average System Interruption Duration is impacted by only 0.03 minutes; to be compared to 0.17 minutes due to insulation failure in the main substation and 20 minutes due to cable failure. With respect to security of operation it is found that the major part of the insulation failures leads to earth fault currents readily interrupted by upstream protection without physical degradation of the equipment. It is concluded that a complete substitution in MV distribution networks by vacuum switch-disconnectors has a negligible impact on reliability and safety.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation method of HVDN based on function group decomposition theory and its application
abstract: Function group decomposition thought is proposed in this paper. The function group decomposition is a process which decomposes electrical network into topological structure of function groups, according to the extent of main protection for system element. Based on function group decomposition thought, a reliability evaluation models considering both substation bus arrangement and high voltage distribution network structure is produced. System of systemic index and node index is also brought forward. Based power flow computation and optimization theory, a reliability evaluation algorithm is established, which reflects system failure behaviors and optimized adjustment behaviors. The above method is utilized in reliability evaluation of Urumqi HVDN structure schemes in 2015. The related research indicated that the results by this method are credible. The method has good application prospect.

articleTitle: Simulation and realization of closed loop control system of SSSC based on RTDS
abstract: Static Synchronous Series Compensator(SSSC)which is regarded as a newly developed FACTS equipment with extensive applying prospects has received more and more attentions recently. This paper has adopted three single phase of cascaded converter as the main circuit of SSSC and SVPWM based on KL coordinates as the modulation algorithm. Considering the characteristics of main circuit structure and SSSC function,a method was proposed to control cascaded converter by DSP+FPGA aiming at supplying enough PWM pulses because there are many switch components in multi-level converter. The present paper introduced the functional module configuration of the whole closed loop control system from two aspects of hardware platform design and software control algorithms realization. Finally in the present paper the SSSC controller were testified to be effective by simulation results in which the external electric power system and the main circuit of SSSC converter were simulated in RTDS while the controller adopted the hardware connection method of DSP+FPGA.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic partial discharge detection using negentropy-based matched filter
abstract: It is essential to detect and localize partial discharge in a nondestructive test, which ensures reliable, long-term operation of critical power apparatus under high voltage stress. In this paper, the ultrasonic detection method combined with electrical PD detection method is used to detect the typical internal PD in transformer. The ultrasonic signals are polluted by various noises when power apparatus operate. The matched filter based on negentropy is presented to detect the ultrasonic PD signal hidden in noises. The simulation and experimental tests demonstrate that the matched filter proposed in the paper suppress the interference signals effectively, and extract the clearly ultrasonic PD signal to enhance the reliability of identification. By producing three-dimensional distributions, it is proved the validity of the ultrasonic detection method.

articleTitle: Centralized management platform of distributed recording system Based on IP network
abstract: The substation recording system is independent, the control center can not effectively monitoring on its operational status and cannot achieve more centralized management, cannot immediately find malfunction. So Put forward through the IP networking with straight unicom establish dispatching center of centralized management platform, make recordings in different geographic location of substation scheduling recording system can be recorded by the IP network to collect information on the server, users in the IP network in any site simply login server to other sites will be recording information query and maintenance management, so as to realize the substation of recording equipment and unified management, improving the scheduling recording system operation and maintenance convenience, timeliness.

articleTitle: Optimal planning of substation locating based on GIS and refined multi-team PSO algorithm
abstract: A new intelligent algorithm, improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, is presented to handle optimal substation locating problem. Simulated annealing and mutation operator will be considered to introduce in this PSO algorithm, so it guarantee the multiplicity of colony in the computational initial period and enhance the optimization decimal of the algorithm in the later period. The paper firstly introduces the geographic information as Metadata factor into the model. Through an analysis of the examples, the paper finally provides a reference to the distribution network planning and construction.

articleTitle: Research on fault line detection and restraining transient over-voltage under arc-suppression coil with paralleled resistance grounding mode
abstract: The principle of fault line detection and restraining transient over-voltage under arc-suppression coil with paralleled resistance grounding mode was proposed in this paper. It was verified by simulation. Compared with other grounding mode, its superiority was displayed. The value of paralleled resistance was determined at last.

articleTitle: The electrical model and parameter design of hybrid railway unified power quality controller (RUPQC)
abstract: Negative-sequence and harmonic pollution threats the safe operation of the traction supply system and the utility grid. To overcome the shortage of railway static power conditioner (RPC) for canceling negative-sequence and harmonic current, a novel hybrid railway unified power quality compensator (RUPQC) is proposed to reduce the rating of voltage source inverter (VSI) in the compensator in this paper. The RUPQC is consisted of RPC, thyristor controlled reactor (TCR) and thyristor controlled high-pass filter (TCHF), which are connected to the traction sections in parallel. The general principle of RUPQC is analyzed in this paper, and the electric model of the RUPQC is established. Furthermore, the parameter selection method of RUPQC is discussed. Simulation and experimental results verified the validity of proposed compensator.

articleTitle: Online insulation monitoring system of high-voltage capacitive substation equipment based on WSN
abstract: This paper introduces an online insulation monitoring system of high-voltage capacitive substation equipment based on Zigbee wireless sensor network. According to the voltage level, a number of Zigbee subnets are installed in the substation to measure the leakage current of the capacitive equipment with the improved accuracy and reliability of the measurement. The clocks of different devices are synchronized to realize the synchronized phase measurements and achieve the precise dielectric loss factor. Several Zigbee subnets construct the sensor net of the substation capacitive equipment state monitoring system. The monitoring master of capacitive devices can be included in the intelligent substation automation system as interval level devices, and can also be connected to a distance substation monitoring master through 3G communication network.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation system and power supply scheme for large-scale and extra-high power electric arc furnace connected to the grid
abstract: This paper analyzes adverse effect of electric arc furnace impact load on grid power quality and generator operation etc., starting from operating characteristics of electric arc furnace, and proposes evaluation system, evaluation program, and treatment measures for connection of EAF to grid. Through study of factors affecting power supply scheme for large scale extra-high power electric arc furnace, it is known that the key of power supply scheme selection is voltage fluctuation and flicker caused by connection of EAF to grid and the effect on generator shafting. Using the distributed power supply scheme for the 6 extra-high power EAF in Zhangjiagang region as an instance, an improved scheme of power supply to large scale extra-high power EAF is proposed, i.e. construction of 500kV Jinfeng Substation that will be exclusively used for EAF loads. Results of simulation show that this scheme can greatly improve public supply network power quality and reduce effect on generator shafting.

articleTitle: Protection performance analysis and settings during power black-start of northern Jiangsu district
abstract: By analyzing features of the power black-start system of northern Jiangsu district, the line current differential protection was set as the main protection for black-start path. Based on analysis of failure of black-start system, the fault current and voltage were verified to meet the distance and zero-sequence protection requirements. Furthermore, problems and solutions of back-up distance protection in the black-start system were particularly analyzed.

articleTitle: On service restoration considering frequency property of distributed generation
abstract: In order to solve the problem of service restoration in distribution network based on distributed generation, this paper treated it as a multi-object nonlinear optimization problem with constrains like the type, capacity and priority of important loads. In this paper, four possible operation modes are considered, and loads are divided into three levels. Further, islanding algorithm based on a new judging method is used to check network connectivity; load shed and network reconfiguration strategies based on bacterial colony chemotaxis optimization algorithm is proposed to achieve the objections of maximum load restoration and minimum switch action; and the flexible power flow algorithm is used to check system frequency constrain. In the end, the service restoration strategy is verified using IEEE 33-node system, and simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Gridless net routing of integrate circuit with Particle Swarm optimization algorithm
abstract: Particle Swarm optimization algorithm is presented for the layout of IC design. Particle swarm optimization based on swarm intelligence is a new evolutionary computational tool and is successfully applied in function optimization, neural network design, classification, pattern recognition, signal processing and robot technology and so on. A modified algorithm is presented and applied to the layout of IC design.
