For a given layout plane, first of all, this algorithm generates the corresponding grid group by barriers and nets' ports with the thought of gridless net routing, establishes initialization fuzzy matrix, then utilizes the global optimization character to find out the best layout route only if it exits. The results of model simulation indicate that PSO algorithm is feasible and efficient in IC layout design.

articleTitle: Regional power grid voltage and reactive power control system for intelligent real-time simulation and evaluation system
abstract: Since voltage control may result in voltage frequent adjustments and voltage regulation unreasonable phenomenon, so, before AVC closed loop control running the strategy must be implemented strictly functional and performance testing and verification, to ensure zero risk after put into operation. This paper develops a comprehensive simulation environment and effective means of assessment is expected to put into operation and has been in operation in the area reactive power real-time control system safety analysis and validity assessment. The core of the system framework is responsible for the system data exchange, task scheduling and the results show a visual platform; the remaining part of the independent modules, namely: intelligent simulation module, the standard voltage and reactive power control module, intelligent evaluation modules, intelligent case generator module. This new model is ideal for simulation and assessment of the existing power system in the assessment of different AVC systems which will soon be applied in the Guangdong provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Power system harmonic state estimation based on PMU and ridge estimation
abstract: With the development of measurement in node voltage, branch current and nodal injection current phasor measurement system (PMU), the phase measurement system provides a new idea for power system's online analysis. For the harmonic state estimation, we mainly use the PMU synchronized sampling which installed in different points of factory, that is, data acquisition device installed in different plants, the sampling time is synchronized to the same time base, which are the data harmonic state estimation required. Set up a simulation system layout the measurement points in a reasonable way, considering the points which measurement voltage and current values as a known quantity, establish a mathematical model. Applying the generalized ridge estimate to solve the mathematical model in order to obtain the harmonic voltage of each node in the system, and then determine the system's harmonic state.

articleTitle: Electricity intensity analysis of key industries in East China region based on Grey Relational analysis
abstract: Energy-saving emission reduction (ESER) is the key project of our society, and electricity energy saving is actually one of the most important parts to contribute ESER. The effect of electricity energy saving will have a bearing on the success or failure of ESER. Because the implementation process of ESER policy is now with quite short time period allowed and there will be a large amount of uncertainties within the implementation of the policy, these have imposed many challenges to achieve the ESER target. In this paper, a new method is proposed to analyze the relationship between the electricity intensity of key industries and the whole industrial electricity intensity to determine the critical industry of a certain region, which could integrate Grey Relational Theory, and implement in-depth relation analysis. Then the method is used to make the systematic analysis in East China region to check its feasibility for electricity energy saving. Finally, the critical industry for the electricity energy saving of East China region is determined and the analyzed result could provide a great help to the decision making about ESER of East China region

articleTitle: How to shorten the examining and testing time of the GIS equipment anti-mishandling system in substations
abstract: The importance and safety of the anti-mishandling system for the 220kV substations is of top-grade for the operators. But the examining and testing time always lasts several working days, which put a fairly heavy pressure on the operators in the existing state and will also influence the commissioning date of the newly set equipment. This paper discussed how to shorten the examining and testing time of the substations' GIS equipment and enhance the efficiency of such work..

articleTitle: Research on assessment method for the reliability of the urban power grid based on Multi-Model technology
abstract: Real-time operation reliability assessment of the urban power grid is the precondition of self-healing control of Smart Grid. Analysis influence factors of operation reliability of the urban power grid, define assessment index, and calculate it use Multi-Model technology. Simulation is preformed for an urban power grid, the results showing that the proposed assessment method based on Multi-Model technology is capable.

articleTitle: Discussion on dynamic var compensation scheme of wind power station
abstract: The change of active and reactive output of wind power station is quite random. If no appropriate reactive regulation is adopted, the voltage change of common connecting points will be frequently. After large-scale wind power station has been connected into the power grid, it will not only affect the power quality of the power grid but also endanger the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This paper has made detailed analysis and calculation of mode and capacity of reactive power compensation of wind power station from the angle of voltage control and power factor control and raises a dynamic var compensation scheme which is suitable for wind power station in coastal area of Jiangsu, providing reference for construction and operation of wind power station in other regions.

articleTitle: Case analysis of Yangzhou Energy Mechanism Conservation
abstract: Energy Mechanism Conservation (EMC) is a successful internationally-run energy efficiency financing mode. This mode promotes a new energy efficient financial management method instead of selling products or techniques. In this mode, the Energy Service Company (ESCO) signs contracts with customers (enterprises or organizations) who shall pay for the cost of energy efficiency program in accordance with energy conservation during the contract term, and the two parties shall share financing risks together. Yangzhou Coal Quality Inspection Service Center (ESCO) runs outstanding EMC for enterprises like Jiangsu Yin Bao Industry Co., Ltd and Gao You Jing Wei Textile Co., Ltd. This paper conducts case analysis of EMC in Jiangsu Yin Bao Industry Co., Ltd, elaborates problems encountered in the implementation of EMC and puts forward suggestions so as to have EMC well-received by companies with its scientific and reasonable marketing.

articleTitle: Investigation and application of double mode technology for automatic meter reading
abstract: This paper introduced the present situation of automatic meter reading. Problems existed in power line carrier communication and wireless communication were proposed. The scheme of automatic reading system based on double mode technology was presented, and schemes were compared from the probability point of view. Besides the system was tested and analyzed. The results verified that the system possessed advantages such as high real-time reading rate, good communication effect, and steady operational status.

articleTitle: Prevention and treatment to over-voltage of low voltage distribution network
abstract: According to the over-voltage of low voltage distribution network at present, this paper proposes some treatment methods by installing protection integration equipment to prevent the over-voltage, over-current and leakage of electricity. The practical applications prove this method can prevent effectually electrical devices disconnection and this protection equipment's configuration is simple and conveniently used.

articleTitle: The initial exploration on application of EMC in grid enterprise
abstract: This paper analyses the advantages of EMC in improving power efficiency, reducing energy cost and improving economy benefit. It deals with the strategy project of energy- saving, carbon-emission reduction,

articleTitle: A method of flicker measurement based on pisarenko harmonic decomposition
abstract: In this paper a novel flicker measurement method is proposed after studying the IEC flicker meter. This method need spectral analyze the wave component to calculate the instantaneous flicker sensation level, and then the pisarenko harmonic decomposition (PHD) is used to obtain the amplitude and the frequency of wave components. To process the wave component by PHD can acquire precise spectrums. The IEC flicker meter and novel method is compared in simulation and test. The result verified the correctness and efficiency of the theoretical prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of failures and “blind spots” of ZYQ-11S/12S voltage switching box for PXH-831/801E protection screen
abstract: ZYQ-11S/12S voltage switching boxes are important components of PXH-831/801E protection screen. Bus P.T secondary alternating voltage at I and II sections of power substation will be switched in the box and then transmitted to corresponding protective devices. The author has analyzed carefully on several failures under special operating conditions of ZYQ-11S/12S voltage switching boxes. Lay out every possible incentive that may lead to accidents according to the device principle, examine and exclude one by one and then base on occurring characteristics of accidents to reveal the real cause with sufficient reasons—the device has “blind spot”. And therefore take relevant measures accordingly in practice to avoid of such incidents happening again.

articleTitle: Based on the integration of the genetic principle of ant colony algorithm for distribution network restoration applications
abstract: The distribution network fault recovery described, made light of the actual distribution network recovery objective function, the analysis of genetic algorithms and ant colony algorithm based on the combination of genetic algorithms and ant colony count of the respective merits of proposed A genetic algorithm into the new strategy of ant colony algorithm using the genetic algorithm has stronger global search ability, look for a group of large-scale solution, and then as a basis, using ant colony algorithm is fast to find the optimal solution is constructed based on genetic algorithm hybrid ant colony algorithm. Case analysis shows that the algorithm has fast convergence speed and a strong prime global search capabilities,to avoid premature convergence, effectively improving the power supply to restore the speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an integrated micro-grid system
abstract: Microgrid technology, becoming the main application form of distributed generation with high permeability, can effectively alleviate the impacts on large power grid of distributed generation. Microgrid system, as the carrier of microgrid control strategy, can provide verification platform for the research of microgrid control strategy. In this paper, an integrated microgrid system with flexible structure and reliable multi-microgrids system structure is proposed which contains a variety of distributed generations and energy storage systems. The small microgrids can operate separately or in the form of one large microgrid. And this system, using master-slave control strategy, can switch flexibly between grid-connected operation mode and independent operation mode. Meanwhile, the experiments for control, protection and other technologies have been made. It shows that this system can work well with operation control and other related technologies.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of the smart distribution network by the Yangjiaping Power Supply Bureau
abstract: Early in 1999 the Yangjiaping Power Supply Bureau started to explore power distribution automation which was then put into operation in 2005 and passed the examination of the Chongqing Electric Power Corp. With ten years efforts of construction, operation, exploration, the Yangjiaping power distribution automation system has been operating in a stable way and has provided a cogent guarantee for the safe operation of the distribution grid. This paper first analyzes the structure of the power distribution automation system and then gives an account of its functions and characteristics. The system explores the application of high technology in smart distribution room, communication network of the distribution system based on EPON and precise fault location in low-voltage distribution automation.

Author Keywords: precise location in low-voltage distribution automation
communication network of the distribution system based on EPON

articleTitle: Research on Smart Grid application and its design in building the new Beichuan county
abstract: Based on clarifying the feature of power supply and consumption in the new Beichuan county, this paper establishes the whole framework of building the Strong Smart Grid and the main design point in transmission, substation, distribution, dispatching, communication, etc. This paper also elaborates the key technologies of building smart grid in self-healing distribution network, complete communication system, smart SCADA system and the utilization of new power supply and consumption facility, etc. At last, the paper looks into the future of building smart gird in the new Beichuan county.

articleTitle: Optimal 110/10kV substations planning
abstract: This paper presents a new mathematical optimization model to determine the transformer capacity, conductor size and number of transformers and substations in an electric distribution system, in consideration of its special characteristics. In the model, many aspects of the operational and maintenance costs of the electric distribution system are considered. The principles of distribution network planning are discussed based on the proposed model in the paper. A genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem with all constraints respected. The results of a computational example suggest the effectiveness of this proposed method.

articleTitle: A venezuelan experience in the reduction of non-technical power losses
abstract: In the period 2003-2007, Electricidad de Valencia (Eleval), a private power distribution utility with 100 years in Venezuela, developed and implemented a management model to reduce non-technical losses. The strategic approach used was based on identifying the customer's opinion as a result of the alignment of objectives, which allowed generating a strategic plan that led to the harmonic design of four (4) action plans: 1- Adaptation of work processes; 2- Communications and community plan; 3- Follow-up and preventive control plan; and 4- Technological update plans. These four action plans were developed and implemented in Eleval in four years with reduction in total losses from 25% to 12% and adoption of a methodology to maintain, in turn, the reduction and control of the loss index.

articleTitle: A solution for monitoring and controlling the Micro-grid with REN&DER and CCHP based on CSPA-2000(FDCS)
abstract: This paper studies the control system requirement and key technique for the Micro-grid with REN&DER and CCHP, introduces the framework of CSPA-2000(FDCS) distributed automation system, including distributed control structure with distributed power and load, multiple DPU cooperative control, remote monitoring to multiple REN&DER systems, and introduces CCHP and joint control ways of multiple distribution power with a practical application in FOSHAN Power Supply Bureau using this system.
